Stand with Jenin: Urgent relief aid needed!

","description":"

Key Points:

  • Jenin incursion was the biggest military invasion in 20 years into the occupied West Bank
  • Two days of large-scale attacks have left at least 13 Palestinians dead and wounded more than 100, drove thousands from their homes and left a wide swath of damage in its wake
  • Rescue missions are scrambling against time to help the victims on the ground

Campaign Story

In what has been described as the biggest military invasion into the occupied West Bank in 20 years, rescue teams are frantically organizing relief aid to those affected by the carnage.

The attackers began withdrawing forces from the area after two days of a large-scale incursions that also left at least 13 Palestinians dead, wounded more than 100, drove thousands from their homes and left a wide swath of damage in its wake.

Palestine's Foreign Ministry labelled the escalation "open war against the people of Jenin".

Medical charity Doctors Without Borders also condemned the firing of tear gas inside Khalil Suleiman hospital in Jenin, calling it "unacceptable".

Palestine's Health Minister Mai al-Kaila even accused the army of shooting at Palestinians in a courtyard of the Jenin public hospital.

"The most dangerous is what happened inside the camp, where there is no electricity, no water, and no roads for those who need to go to hospital," Jenin mayor Nidal Abu Saleh told AFP.

Around 3,000 people had fled their homes in the refugee camp since the assault commenced, said deputy governor of Jenin, Kamal Abu al-Roub.

Imad Jabarin, one of those leaving the rubble-strewn camp, said "all aspects of life have been destroyed, there is no electricity and no communications... we are cut off from the world to some extent".

 

Our partners are on the ground ready to assist with relief aid, providing daily needs for the hospitals, which amounts to USD 10,000 per day. Additionally, supplying medical devices to hospitals for USD 39,000, including 6 external fixation devices, 2 D.C. shock machines and 4 Doppler machines.

Let's all come together at this crucial point in time and help them in whatever way we can. Please share this campaign far and wide to reach maximum impact and #CirculateGood

One child, one Quran

","description":"

In early 2022, we arranged a distribution of 300 copies of the Qur'an in a few rural areas in the Bauchi state of Nigeria, much to the delight of the children there as a majority of them cannot afford to purchase their own.

However, we quickly realized that it was barely enough as some of the children didn’t get one to take home for their own use, and are still dependent on borrowing a Quran from others.

That’s where the aim of this project comes in. To date, we’ve distributed around 4500 copies but our ultimate goal is to give out 100,000 copies of the Holy Quran, insha Allah.

Please help us to support this campaign, as many come from poor families from the rural areas, where their parents have very little or limited sources of income.

Translation of The Quran into Rohingya Script

","description":"

 

 

Key Points:

  • Transcribing the Quran into the Rohingya script for the first time in history.
  • Translating, editing, proofreading, and ensuring linguistic accuracy.
  • Developing a mobile app for both Android and iOS, accessible offline for marginalized users.
  • Expanding digital access to the Quran across Rohingya communities worldwide.

 

Campaign Story

Following the successful completion of Phase 1, the first-ever verbal translation of the Quran for millions of Rohingya people has reached a historic milestone with profound spiritual and educational impact. Through the complete audio and visual translation of all 114 Surahs, the word of Allah has now reached millions of Rohingya worldwide.

Many schools across the Rohingya diaspora—including refugee camps in Bangladesh and learning centres in Malaysia—have adopted this resource as part of their daily lessons to connect students to the words of Allah.

Building upon this success, Phase 2 of the project focuses on transcribing and translating the Quran into the Rohingya script, producing downloadable and printable text editions, and developing a mobile application. The app is designed to function offline, ensuring access for marginalized Rohingya communities with limited internet connectivity. This dedicated digital platform will enable users to read, learn, and connect to the words of Allah in their own language—an achievement that will inspire and guide generations to come.

Alhamdulillah, more than 10 Juz have been completed in the second phase of the project—fully transcribed, edited, and proofread in the Rohingya script. The mobile application has been successfully developed and launched on both Android and iOS platforms, featuring offline access and downloadable audio and text of the Quran. The app has already achieved thousands of downloads globally, reflecting strong user engagement and community demand.

We now aim to complete the remaining 20 Juz, integrate them into the mobile platform, and continue our ongoing translation, review, and quality assurance to uphold the highest standards of linguistic accuracy and clarity. This phase will significantly expand digital access to the Quran in the Rohingya language, empowering individuals across diaspora communities and refugee camps to connect with the words of Allah in their own tongue.


Join us in making this historic effort a reality. Your support will help complete the full translation and transcription of the Quran in the Rohingya script—giving thousands more the chance to read and understand the Book of Allah in their own language.

Donate today and be part of a legacy that will guide and inspire generations to come.

Help The Visually Impaired Read Quran

","description":"

Key Points:

  • Specially printed Braille Qurans are needed for PERTIS to run Quran classes for the visually impaired in Malaysia
  • PERTIS is the only authorized body in Malaysia to print these Braille Qurans
  • Each printed Braille Quran costs MYR 470 (USD 100)

 

Campaign Story

Empowering Through Education and Inclusion

At PERTIS, we are committed to making a meaningful impact through our initiatives. Alongside producing braille reading materials, we actively organize Quran reading classes at both central and regional levels. Our dedicated teachers are specially trained to instruct using the Quran Mushaf Othmani script.

But that's not all. We also invest in human capital development, nurturing future leaders with the charisma and skills needed to lead PERTIS and advocate for social change. To achieve these goals, we require suitable spaces to conduct training and launch various programs – an investment that ultimately saves costs and drives our mission forward.

Trusted Providers of Braille Quran Materials

PERTIS is proud to be the exclusive entity authorized by the Jabatan Kemajuan Islam Malaysia (JAKIM) and the Ministry of Home Affairs (KDN) to publish and distribute/sell  Braille Qurans in the Uthmani script. These materials are continually produced to meet the needs of visually impaired Muslim individuals, including those with special needs.

Our reach extends beyond Malaysia, as we've distributed these essential materials to countries like Singapore, Brunei, and Indonesia. By supporting us, you're contributing to a vital cause that transcends borders and makes the Quran accessible to all.

Help us to reach our goal of printing 1000 copies of the Braille Qurans, to enable us to facilitate the Quran classes to be taught at our premises. As each copy costs MYR 470 (USD 100), it may not be affordable to all.

Thank you for being part of our mission to empower, educate, and include. Together, we can create a more inclusive society.

Imagine millions of people reading from a Quran you donated.

","description":"

Key Points:

  • Up to 1000 Quran donors have the unique opportunity to gift a Quran as a waqf to be placed inside Masjid al-Haram.
  • 1 Quran (Green - 14x20 - Normal Size) - MYR 85
  • 1 Quran (Blue - 20x29 - Large Size) - MYR 100
  • Every time that someone reads from your gifted copy, you get a reward for that, and that reward is further multiplied because of the blessed location.
  • This is Phase 07 of our Quran Waqf Project.

Picture updates of verification stamps being placed and the copies being handed over to the Masjid al-Haram authorities during Phase 01, Phase 02, Phase 03, Phase 04, Phase 05 and Phase 06 can be viewed here and here. 

The Campaign

More than 13.5 million Muslims performed Umrah in 2023 alone. Imagine if even a quarter of them—over 3 million people—held the Quran you donated in Masjid al-Haram, reciting its verses in worship. Each word they recite becomes a light in their hearts and an unending stream of blessings for your soul.

By donating a Quran through this campaign, you’re placing a copy directly into the hands of these worshippers in one of Islam’s holiest sites.

Every verse recited from your gifted Quran not only nourishes the soul of the reader but also multiplies your rewards. The Prophet Muhammad (ﷺ) said: “Whoever recites a letter from the Book of Allah, he will receive one good deed as ten good deeds like it. I do not say that Alif Lam Mim is one letter, but rather Alif is a letter, Lam is a letter, and Mim is a letter.” [Sunan al-Tirmidhī]

Through our trusted partners, Dawah Corner Bookstore (DCB), and the Official Mushaf Management body of Masjid al-Haram, we ensure that every Quran follows strict protocols for placement in the Blessed Masjid. Unlike unauthorized copies that may be removed, your donation is officially approved and remains accessible for years to come.

Consider this: with millions visiting Masjid al-Haram annually, your single donation has the potential to transform countless lives, guiding hearts closer to Allah.

The Prophet (ﷺ) also said: “Whoever guides someone to goodness will have a reward like one who did it.” [Ṣahih Muslim]

  • Transform Lives with Every Recitation: Your donation places a Quran in the hands of worshippers in Masjid al-Haram, enriching their worship and bringing them closer to Allah.

  • Impact Millions Annually: Your Quran has the potential to touch millions of lives, magnifying the impact of your sadaqah jariyah (ongoing charity).

Blessed meat in the most Holy land on Earth

","description":"

UPDATE: Qurban 2024 in Makkah has been performed, alhamdulillah.

Key Points:

  • Cost of 1 sheep = MYR 450 (USD 95)
  • This campaign gives our donors the unique opportunity to do their Qurban in Makkah
  • Those wishing to just feed the poor in Makkah and distribute meat to them can also support this campaign
  • Donations to this campaign will be used to distribute meat to the poor families in the blessed city of Makkah
  • Because of the heavy volume for Qurban in Makkah, individual qurban pictures will not be possible for this campaign

Campaign Story

Makkah is the holiest city on earth that is the cradle of the Islamic civilization. This campaign gives our donors the unique opportunity to do their Qurban in Makkah. Those wishing to just feed the poor in Makkah and distribute meat to them can also support this campaign. Our partners source the sheep from local farms to help support small businesses as well. 

Cost of 1 Sheep = MYR 450 (USD 95)

After careful research and proper verification a list is formed of those who are the most needy families. The preparation of this list is done with a lot of care so that meat reaches those who are really deserving. To ensure the best performance, our on-ground partner distributes the meat to the poor of Makkah physically by visiting them in their respective neighbourhoods. The meat is packaged and stored before distribution to ensure that optimum quality is maintained at all times. The team on the ground will be fulfilling all Islamic principles and requirements as per proper Islamic teachings. 

The surplus meat (if any) is handed to the Adahi organisation, the official Government body of Saudi Arabia that handles the distribution externally. The meat will be packed and frozen and then shipped internationally to 37 needy Islamic countries such as Bangladesh, Pakistan, Azerbaijan, Iraq, Syria, Lebanon, Palestine, Jordan, Djibouti, Sudan, Chad, Niger, Mali, Burkina Faso, Mauritania, Ghana, Liberia, Sierra Leone, Guinea, Conakry, Guinea Bissau, Comoros, Mozambique.

Donations to this campaign will be used to distribute meat to the poor families in the blessed city of Makkah.

Your sacrifice done for these people will bring them huge relief and great joy on this auspicious occasion of Eid. Donations to this campaign will help provide meat packages to these poor and needy Muslims so that they also get the chance to forget their sorrows and make the most out of Eid.

The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, 'Whoever recites a letter from the Book of Allah, he will be credited with a good deed, and a good deed gets a ten-fold reward. I do not say that Alif-Lam-Mim is one letter, but Alif is a letter, Lam is a letter and Mim is a letter.' [Tirmidhi] The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, “Whoever guides someone to goodness will have a reward like one who did it.” [Muslim] 

Through our partners, Dawah Corner Bookstore (DCB) who are working in cooperation with the Official Mushaf Management body of Masjid al-Haram, our donors have the unique opportunity to gift a Quran as a waqf to be placed inside Masjid al-Haram. It needs to be noted that not just any random copy of the Quran can be placed in the blessed Masjid. It needs to follow certain rules, protocols and seals of approval. Many visitors buy copies of the Quran at the gates of the Masjid to be placed inside, but they don't know that they are later removed by the Masjid authorities. The copies of the Quran gifted through this campaign will go though the official channels and will have all the proper seals of waqf to be placed in the Blessed Masjid.  

1 Quran (Green - 14x20 - Normal Size) - MYR 61

1 Quran (Blue - 20x29 - Large Size) - MYR 96 

It has been more than a year now that many of us have not been able to travel because of Covid-19 restrictions. All the plans that we might have had to visit Makkah and Madinah were put on hold or cancelled. Let's use this opportunity to gift a copy of the Quran as a Waqf to Masjid al-Haram in 3 simple clicks. May Allah invite us all to His Blessed Home soon

Name: Berrypay (M) Sdn Bhd
Account: 109920002717
Reference: DCB Quran

BerryPay is our official payment gateway.

If you have made a direct bank transfer. Please send your transfer proof to hello@globalsadaqah.com or via WhatsApp to +60333100069

Qurban for Poor Families in Makkah (Sheep)

","description":"

Key Points:

  • Cost of 1 Sheep = MYR 500 (USD 109)
  • This campaign gives our donors the unique opportunity to do their Qurban in Makkah
  • Those wishing to just feed the poor in Makkah and distribute meat to them can also support this campaign
  • Donations to this campaign will be used to distribute meat to the poor families in the blessed city of Makkah
  • Because of the heavy volume for Qurban in Makkah, individual qurban pictures will not be possible for this campaign

Campaign Story:

Makkah is the holiest city on earth that is the cradle of the Islamic civilization. This campaign gives our donors the unique opportunity to do their Qurban in Makkah. Those wishing to just feed the poor in Makkah and distribute meat to them can also support this campaign. Our partners source the sheep from local farms to help support small businesses as well. 

Cost of 1 Sheep = MYR 500 (USD 108)

After careful research and proper verification a list is formed of those who are the most needy families. The preparation of this list is done with a lot of care so that meat reaches those who are really deserving. To ensure the best performance, our on-ground partner distributes the meat to the poor of Makkah physically by visiting them in their respective neighbourhoods. The meat is packaged and stored before distribution to ensure that optimum quality is maintained at all times. The team on the ground will be fulfilling all Islamic principles and requirements as per proper Islamic teachings. 

The surplus meat (if any) is handed to the Adahi organisation, the official Government body of Saudi Arabia that handles the distribution externally. The meat will be packed and frozen and then shipped internationally to 37 needy Islamic countries such as Bangladesh, Pakistan, Azerbaijan, Iraq, Syria, Lebanon, Palestine, Jordan, Djibouti, Sudan, Chad, Niger, Mali, Burkina Faso, Mauritania, Ghana, Liberia, Sierra Leone, Guinea, Conakry, Guinea Bissau, Comoros, Mozambique.

Donations to this campaign will be used to distribute meat to the poor families in the blessed city of Makkah.

Let’s start with just MYR 10 and help feed our brothers and sisters and spread smiles in the holiest city on the globe. 

Your sacrifice done for these people will bring them huge relief and great joy on this auspicious occasion of Eid. Donations to this campaign will help provide meat packages to these poor and needy Muslims so that they also get the chance to forget their sorrows and make the most out of Eid.

Support the Spiritual Growth and Discipline of Orphaned Children in Kelantan

","description":"

Key Points

  • Build strong spiritual roots through structured Quran memorisation and tadabbur.
  • Instil discipline and adab through weekly Quranics and character-building sessions.
  • Sponsor 10–20 students and 1–2 teachers for the launch of the tahfiz programme.
  • Track real impact through memorisation reports, progress updates, and media content.
  • Support a long-term vision to raise a Quranic, skilled, and socially conscious generation.

Campaign Story

For over 30 years, PEKA YATIM in Kelantan has been a haven for orphaned children, offering them shelter, care, and the chance at a better future. These are children who have lost not just parents, but stability, support, and often, hope.

Today, with rising costs and increasing needs, PEKA YATIM is launching Projek Resmi Budi — a long-term campaign to strengthen the lives of orphans and underprivileged families through education, welfare, and spiritual development.

------

Phase 1: Tahfiz & Discipline focuses on building the hearts and habits of young children by providing structured Quran memorisation, spiritual reflection, and character training.

We’re starting small but meaningful — with 10–20 students, 1–2 qualified teachers, and a tailored tahfiz programme that tracks memorisation progress and instils Islamic values and discipline. Regular social media updates will document their journey and inspire community support.

Help us lay the spiritual foundation these children need to grow into confident, skilled, and Quranic-driven individuals. With your donation, you become part of their story — and of a generation raised on the Book of Allah.

 

🎯 Outcome:

Children with strong spiritual grounding, disciplined habits, and a foundation for future excellence, while the organisation develops a measurable “track record” to scale future phases of the project.

Projek Resmi Budi is a 3-phase initiative crafted to nurture well-rounded, resilient youth at PEKA YATIM. Phase 1 begins with spiritual growth through tahfiz and discipline. Phase 2 will equip them with essential life skills, including archery and self-defence. Phase 3 focuses on upgrading and maintaining facilities to create a safe and empowering environment for their development. Together, these phases aim to build a generation that is Quranic, skilled, and confident.

progressText:
{"props":{"pageProps":{"status":true,"msg":"Campaign details","data":{"id":79007,"title":"A Place To Belong : Rebuilding hope, Restoring Dignity For Every Orphaned Child (Phase 1)","slug":"a-place-to-belong","cover_image":"https://admin.globalsadaqah.com/uploads/galleries/image_68cb8a58b4cbf_1758169688.jpg","cover_image_details":{"id":1953,"path":"uploads/galleries/image_68cb8a58b4cbf_1758169688.jpg","title":"6.jpg","description":"","caption":"","alt_text":""},"thumb_caption":"

Rebuild Their Future

","description":"

Key Campaign Goals

  • Rebuild and repair dormitories, classrooms, surau, and basic facilities.
  • Provide safe, clean, and supportive spaces for learning and living.
  • Create better areas for sports, social, and educational activities.
  • Involve the community and donors in long-term, sustainable care.

Campaign Story

For over three decades, Pertubuhan Kebajikan Anak-Anak Yatim Kelantan (PEKA YATIM) has been more than just a shelter — it’s been a family, a school, and a second home for children who’ve lost theirs. 

But time has worn down the walls, the toilets are leaking, dorms are overcrowded, and the library is no longer fit for learning. These children deserve better. They deserve a place to belong — a place that reflects their dignity, nurtures their dreams, and restores their hope. 

This campaign seeks to rebuild that space, one phase at a time. Together, we can restore the dignity every orphaned child deserves.

Who Are the Beneficiaries?

  • 78 orphaned children residing full-time at PEKA YATIM, aged 7–18
  • Local underprivileged families (asnaf) involved in community support programmes 
    under PEKA YATIM 

PHASE 1: Safe Foundations

Target: RM50,000 
Focus Areas: 

  • Refurbishment of the Main Hall (used for daily prayers, group learning, and meals)
  • Full upgrade of Toilet & Sanitary Facilities
  • Resurfacing and construction of Covered Walkways to ensure safe, flood-free access 
    across the orphanage

Assalamualaikum,

 

We are humbled to share a heartfelt update on Project: A Place To Belong, taking place in Malaysia at PEKAYATIM, Desa Rahmat, Kota Bharu, Kelantan.

 

The renovation works have now reached a meaningful milestone. The hall, restroom, and walkway roof are fully usable — transforming what was once a worn and tired space into a clean, bright and welcoming place for children who deserve to feel safe and cared for. Only a few final touch-ups and cleaning remain before this space becomes their new home.

 

This progress represents more than just completed construction. It’s a step closer to giving orphaned children a sense of dignity, belonging, and hope for their future.

 

Here’s what has been completed so far:

  • Exterior painting finished, giving the building a fresh new look
  • Interior hall renovated and spacious, ready for activities and learning
  • Ceiling structure installed and secure
  • Covered walkway completed to provide safe passage
  • New toilet unit fully functioning

 

Here is the link to see the images:

https://ibb.co.com/album/17byh0

 

Next steps:

  • Final cleaning and polishing
  • Electrical safety checks
  • Installation of curtains, partitions, and furnishings
  • Preparation for handover or opening ceremony

 

None of this would be possible without your generosity. But we’re not done yet — your support is urgently needed to complete the renovations and give these children a safe place to belong.

 

Your contribution can be the reason a child smiles, feels safe, and walks into a place they can finally call home. Together, we can finish what we started and build not just a space — but a future filled with hope.

 

Wassalamualaikum,

 

Global Sadaqah Team

Delivering Life-Saving Meals in North Gaza

","description":"

Key Points:

  • 1,000 hot, nutritious meals delivered daily to the most vulnerable in North Gaza.
  • Field Kitchen Project fully operational on the ground — not planned, but ongoing.
  • Serves widows, children, the elderly, and displaced families.
  • Restores dignity and health in a war-torn landscape where food is scarce.
  • Your support is not just food — it’s hope wrapped in warmth and mercy.

Campaign Story:

In North Gaza, survival has become a daily battle.
Relentless bombardment. Water cut-offs. Food blockade.
Families wander for hours — not in search of shelter, but for something as basic as bread.

💔 Children cry not from fear, but from hunger.
💧 Mothers skip meals to feed their babies.
And yet — they endure, they pray, they wait.

But they are not forgotten.

Through this campaign, we are establishing a Field Kitchen in North Gaza — a beacon of mercy in a devastated land. Every meal we cook is a silent message that says:
“We see you. We care. We won’t leave you behind.”

💛 Be the Comfort They Desperately Need
 
Your contribution will help:
✅ Sustain the daily operations of the Field Kitchen
✅ Purchase fresh ingredients and cooking supplies
✅ Pay local kitchen staff and volunteers
✅ Ensure consistent delivery of meals to hard-hit zones
 
In this moment of crisis, a single hot meal can say:
“You are loved. You are remembered. You matter.”
 
👉 Donate now and help us feed Gaza, one heart at a time.

Act Now: Save Lives Affected by Malaysia’s Flood Disaster

","description":"

Key Campaign Points

  • Provide immediate food, clean water, and hygiene supplies to families who are struggling to survive right now
  • Deliver critical baby essentials to mothers with infants who are at high risk
  • Offer urgent medical care and first-aid support during life-threatening emergencies
  • Help families clean and restore their homes once floodwaters recede, so they can return safely
  • Prioritise the most vulnerable groups: children, the elderly, OKU individuals, and low-income families who have nowhere else to turn
  • MRA is part of national (Rakan Nadma) and regional (Asian Disaster Risk Reduction Network) networks coordinating disaster relief and rapid response efforts

Campaign Overview

Every monsoon season, thousands of individuals and families lose their homes, belongings, and sense of security within hours. Floodwaters rise suddenly, forcing people to flee in fear, often with nothing more than the clothes they are wearing.

For more than a decade, MRA has been on the ground responding to these emergencies. We remain on standby every flood season — ready to move at a moment’s notice. Our teams deliver emergency essentials such as food, clean water, hygiene kits, baby supplies, and medical assistance — the lifesaving support families need to survive the first critical hours and days.

When floodwaters finally recede, the struggle isn’t over. Many homes are uninhabitable and families face the overwhelming burden of starting again. MRA prioritises restorative efforts including house cleaning and repairs to household and electrical equipment, so families can return to a safe and livable environment, reducing post-disaster trauma and giving them a chance to rebuild their lives.

This campaign calls on compassionate donors to stand with those who have lost almost everything — and help bring comfort, safety, and hope when it matters most.

Who Are the Beneficiaries

  • Individuals and families affected by severe flooding across Malaysia
  • Communities in high-risk areas such as Kelantan, Terengganu, Perak, Selangor, and others
  • Children, the elderly, OKU individuals, and low-income B40 households with limited ability to recover on their own
  • Families who urgently need assistance to survive and rebuild


Lives are at risk right now.
Your contribution today can be the difference between despair and survival.
Act now — send help before it’s too late. Donate today and save families in crisis.

Indonesia in Crisis: Act Now to Save Lives

","description":"

1. Key Campaign Points

  • Providing emergency relief packages including food supplies, warm clothing, blankets, and hygiene kits to families who have lost access to basic needs.
  • Supplying clean and safe water for drought-affected communities struggling with limited access to drinking water.
  • Constructing temporary shelters (Huntara) to ensure displaced families have a safe and dignified place to stay.
  • Delivering medical assistance and psychological support for survivors experiencing injury, trauma, and grief.
  • Strengthening disaster preparedness to reduce risks from expected floods and landslides in high-risk regions.
  • Ensuring fast, targeted, and transparent distribution so help reaches those in urgent and immediate need.

2. Campaign Overview

Indonesia is facing one of the most challenging humanitarian years in recent history. As one of the most disaster-prone countries in the world, more than 2,590 disasters have already occurred in 2025—leaving thousands of families displaced, vulnerable, and unsure of where to turn.

Floods, landslides, earthquakes, and severe droughts have devastated communities across the nation. In Cilacap, homes lie buried under landslide debris. In Klaten, families wait hours just to collect a few liters of water. And near Mount Semeru, many are still living in temporary tents after losing homes, livelihoods, and loved ones.

Right now, families are struggling to survive with limited access to food, clean water, shelter, and medical care.

Rumah Zakat has activated emergency response teams and is urgently mobilizing aid to affected regions. With your support, we can provide life-saving assistance and help families rebuild with dignity and hope.

3. Who Are the Beneficiaries?

  • Disaster-affected individuals and vulnerable families
  • Communities impacted by floods, droughts, eruptions, landslides, and earthquakes
  • Displaced families currently without shelter or basic necessities
  • High-risk communities preparing for future disaster threats

Priority regions including:

  • Cilacap
  • Klaten
  • Lumajang (Semeru area)
  • Other affected areas across Indonesia

4. Call to Action

This is urgent. Families cannot wait.

Your contribution today can provide safety, warmth, dignity, and hope for those who lost everything in an instant.

Act now. Support Indonesia’s disaster survivors. Save lives today.

Key Points:

  • 🍽️ One Meal, One Act of Mercy: Your RM45 ($10) provides a freshly cooked hot meal for a Palestinian in crisis.
  • 📦 Real Impact, Real Updates: Transparent reporting with regular updates so you see where your donation goes.
  • 🔁 Scale That Grows with You: The more support we receive, the more lives we touch—our goal: hundreds of meals a day.
  • 🤝 Trusted Local Collaboration: Meals prepared and distributed by reliable teams on the ground who understand the real needs.

Campaign Story

In the heart of devastation, where buildings have crumbled and lives have been torn apart, the fight for survival in Palestine continues each day. Amidst bombings, displacement, and grief, one simple need remains—a warm meal.

For thousands of Palestinian families, food has become a distant memory. Kitchens lie in ruins, markets are empty, and the comforting scent of home-cooked meals has vanished. In these moments of despair, the Hot Meals for Palestine campaign was born—not just to fill stomachs, but to restore dignity, bring comfort, and remind our brothers and sisters in Palestine that they are never forgotten.

This initiative, in collaboration with Cinta Syria Malaysia, delivers fresh, nutritious meals daily to the most affected. Each plate represents more than food—it is hope wrapped in rice and bread, mercy poured into a bowl, and solidarity served warm to those who have endured too much for too long.

When you donate, you’re not just giving food.
You’re giving a lifeline. You’re delivering a moment of humanity.

Your Support in Action:
Beneficiaries: 120–150 individuals daily
Meals/Day: 120 hot meal sets
Cost/Meal: $10 | RM45
Daily Cost: $1,200 | RM5,400

Their Next Step Starts With You

","description":"

Key Campaign Points

  • We want to provide Raya and Zemi with properly fitted prosthetic legs made specifically for their bodies, comfort, and mobility needs.
  • Their fittings and medical consultations will be handled by certified professionals to ensure safety and long-term use.
  • We will also support transportation and temporary accommodation during their fitting and adjustment process, so their families are not burdened.
  • More than just mobility, this support will help rebuild their confidence, independence, and sense of normalcy.
  • With the right prosthetic legs, both children can return to school, play with friends, and live their childhood with dignity.

Campaign Overview

Raya and Zemi are children from Indonesia who should be focusing on learning, playing, and dreaming — not worrying about how to take their next step.

Raya, only six years old, lost her left leg and her mother in a heartbreaking accident. Since then, she has been getting through life by hopping on one leg. Her father works hard every day just to cover basic needs, and a prosthetic leg is far beyond what he can afford. Still, Raya remains cheerful and hopeful, believing one day she will walk again.

Zemi was born without his right leg. He once received a prosthetic that allowed him to walk and explore the world like other children. But as he grew, the leg no longer fit and eventually became painful to use. His father works irregularly as a farm laborer, and replacing the prosthetic is something the family simply cannot afford.

Both children deserve more than survival. They deserve movement, confidence, and the chance to grow without feeling left behind.

Who Will Benefit

  • Raya Azzahra, 6 years old, from Cirebon.
  • Zemi, a young child from Majalengka.

Their future does not have to stay this way.
With your support, Raya and Zemi can take their next step — not alone, but with all of us behind them.

This Ramadan, let no one break their fast in hunger. Your generosity can provide a warm meal and bring joy to those in need.

","description":"

Key Points

  • Providing nutritious iftar meals for those who struggle to afford them
  • Supporting orphans, the elderly, low-income families, and daily workers across Indonesia
  • Fulfilling the Sunnah of feeding the fasting and multiplying your rewards in Ramadan
  • Ensuring that no one is left to break their fast in hunger and hardship
  • Every donation brings comfort, sustenance, and smiles to those in need

Campaign Story

As the adhan echoes at Maghrib, millions around the world sit down with their families to break their fast with warm meals and heartfelt prayers. This is the painful reality for many in Indonesia, where poverty and hardship leave countless Muslims without a proper iftar—it is just another reminder of their hardship.

Imagine a child breaking their fast with nothing but water, an elderly person sitting alone with an empty plate, or a laborer returning from a long day’s work only to find no food waiting for them. This is the painful reality for many in Indonesia, where poverty and hardship leave countless Muslims without a proper iftar.

This Ramadan, be the reason someone smiles as they break their fast. Through this campaign, we aim to distribute nutritious iftar meals to those who need them most, ensuring that no one is left behind.
 
🍽 Your donation will provide:
• Warm, nutritious iftar meals for orphans, the elderly, and struggling families
• Relief for daily workers who often go hungry after long hours of labor
• A moment of joy and dignity for those who rarely experience it

The Prophet ﷺ said:
“Whoever feeds a fasting person will have a reward like theirs, without it decreasing from the fasting person’s reward in the slightest.” [Tirmidhi]

Give the Gift of Iftar

Don’t let them go hungry this Ramadan. Donate now and ensure that every fasting person has a meal to break their fast with dignity and joy.

👉 Feed the Fasting – Donate Today!

Because Every Child Deserves to Grow Strong

","description":"

Key Campaign Points

  • Raise public awareness about the importance of balanced nutrition for children.
  • Distribute nutritious food assistance to children and toddlers from low-income families in stunting-prone areas.
  • Support Indonesia’s national program to accelerate stunting reduction.
  • Encourage public participation in building a healthy, strong, and morally grounded generation.

 

Campaign Overview

Across Indonesia, millions of children still face the silent threat of stunting, a condition caused by chronic malnutrition that robs them of their potential to grow, learn, and dream fully.

For many underprivileged families, providing balanced meals every day is a struggle. Children go to bed hungry, and their futures fade quietly before they’ve even begun. But it doesn’t have to be this way.

Through this campaign, Rumah Zakat invites everyone to stand together for Indonesia’s future generation.
Your contribution will provide nutritious food packages, including rice, eggs, vegetables, fruits, and milk, for children and toddlers in stunting-prone regions.

A single plate of nutritious food today is more than a meal, it’s hope, strength, and an investment in our nation’s future.

 

Who Are the Beneficiaries

  • Toddlers and children at risk of stunting.
  • Underprivileged families in rural and low-income communities.
  • Families living in stunting-prone regions across Indonesia.

Don't let another child fade away in silence. Be the reason a child grows taller, learns faster, and dreams bigger. Invest in our nation’s future, today!

{"props":{"pageProps":{"status":true,"msg":"Campaign details","data":{"id":78967,"title":"A Love They Never Had: Give Orphans a Joyous Eid","slug":"a-love-they-never-had-give-orphans-a-joyous-eid","cover_image":"https://admin.globalsadaqah.com/uploads/galleries/image_67ceafad86bc3_1741598637.png","cover_image_details":{"id":1503,"path":"uploads/galleries/image_67ceafad86bc3_1741598637.png","title":"198.png","description":null,"caption":null,"alt_text":null},"thumb_caption":"

This Eid, be the family they never had. Your gift can bring a smile to an orphan’s face.

","description":"

Key Points

  • Bringing Eid joy to orphans and underprivileged children across Indonesia
  • Providing special Eid gift packages filled with food, school supplies, and essentials
  • Following the Sunnah: The Prophet ﷺ promised closeness in Jannah for those who care for orphans
  • Distribution across Aceh to Papua
  • Every donation creates smiles, happiness, and lasting memories

Campaign Story

Eid is a time of joy, family, and celebration. It’s the day children eagerly await—dressing in new clothes, receiving gifts, and feeling the warmth of love. But for orphaned children, Eid often brings loneliness instead of joy.

With no parents to give them gifts, no hands to hold as they walk to the masjid, and no voices to comfort them, their Eid is filled with longing rather than laughter. Many of these children have lost their fathers, and some have lost both parents. Some even have to work at a young age just to survive.

But YOU can change that.

This campaign was created to bring happiness to poor orphans across Indonesia during Eid. By gifting them with Eid packages, we can bring light into their lives and make them feel loved and remembered.
 
📦 Each Eid Gift Package includes:
• UHT Milk
• Canned Cookies
• Biscuits
• Packaged Food (3 kinds)
• Crispy Peanuts (produced by Rumah Zakat’s empowered members)
• 5 Notebooks
• Stationery Pack
• Canvas Tote Bag
• Distribution and Operational Support

Your support will ensure that orphans from Aceh to Papua receive these special gifts on Eid day. Together, we can give them an Eid filled with love, happiness, and dignity—just like every child deserves.

The Prophet ﷺ said:
“I and the one who cares for an orphan will be together in Paradise like this,” and he held his two fingers together. [al-Bukhari]

Be Their Family This Eid!

Donate today and bring the joy of Eid to an orphan. Your kindness will create memories they will cherish forever.

👉 Give Now & Spread Eid Happiness!

Fund a Bicycle and Essentials for a Young Revert.

","description":"

Key Campaign Points

  • Profound Isolation: The family counted only two Muslims: the mother, who tragically passed away, and her young son. He is now struggling for survival and stability alone.
  • The Struggle is Real: Living with an old woman, the boy faces critical food insecurity and hardship during the second half of every month. The anxiety of hunger is constant.
  • Grueling Walk to School: Determined to learn, he is forced to walk an exhausting 10 km round-trip (5 km each way) every single day just to pursue his education.
  • Securing a Future: An additional $\text{RM } 4500$ will be held by An-Nadaa to ensure this crucial, monthly support is sustained, providing him with a stable foundation.

 

Campaign Overview

This is an urgent and heartfelt appeal to support a resilient young boy who has suffered an unimaginable loss. He is one of only two Muslims in his entire family, and the recent death of his mother has left him incredibly vulnerable and isolated.

He currently resides with an old woman, but this fragile arrangement offers little security. Every month, his life is a stark contrast: the first two weeks are stable, but the remaining time is consumed by the fear of hunger and lack of basic necessities.

His determination to seek knowledge is truly inspiring, yet heartbreaking. He must sacrifice precious time and energy by walking an exhausting 10 km daily just to attend school. Our mission is to end his daily burden and secure his future by providing him with a bicycle and establishing consistent monthly support for his essential needs.

 

Who Benefits from Your Compassion?

  • The Boy: You will provide him with stability, safety, and the opportunity to focus on his education without the crushing anxiety of hunger or the exhaustion of a 10 km walk.
  • The Community: You will nurture a young soul who, once supported, can grow into a responsible and contributing member of his local community.
  • The Donors: You will earn immense reward and secure a lasting legacy—a powerful investment in your hereafter by supporting one of the most vulnerable.

 

Funds to be Raised For:

  • Gifting the Boy a Bicycle: To immediately end his grueling 10 km daily walk and preserve his energy for learning.
  • Month-by-Month Support: To cover the necessities of life, including living expenses, education, and essential medical needs, ensuring his stability.

 

This young boy faces overwhelming odds alone. Your compassion can immediately end his daily exhaustion and the constant anxiety of going hungry.

Will you donate today to give him his bicycle and guarantee he never struggles for food again? Every ringgit transforms his life from one of survival to one of hope.

This Ramadhan, your gift is more than food—it’s love, hope, and dignity for struggling families.

","description":"

Key Points

  • Supporting underprivileged families and pre-prosperous communities across Indonesia
  • Distribution covers remote villages and areas near Rumah Zakat service offices
  • Essential food packages to ensure families can observe Ramadhan and celebrate Eid with dignity
  • A chance to turn your charity into lasting blessings this holy month

Campaign Story

Ramadhan and Eid should be a time of joy, not hunger.

While many of us gather around full tables with our families, thousands of underprivileged families in Indonesia face the harsh reality of empty plates and uncertainty. The struggle to provide even the most basic meals turns what should be a season of gratitude into a time of distress.

You can change that.

Through the Family Eid Gifts campaign, we are delivering essential food packages to families in need, from Aceh to Papua. These packages will bring warmth, dignity, and the spirit of Eid into homes that need it most.

Your donation isn’t just about food—it’s about love, hope, and a sense of belonging. It’s a reminder that no family should feel forgotten, especially during this blessed season.

💛 Donate today and let’s share the joy of Eid with those who need it most!

Help A Malaysian Family Rise Above the Flood.

","description":"

Campaign Overview

The recent floods in Sabah have severely impacted the lives of thousands of families in Beaufort, Membakut, Penampang, Papar, Putatan, and Sipitang. Rising waters forced more than 3,100 people from 916 families to leave their homes, submerging 127 villages. Schools, houses, farms, and vital infrastructure have been damaged, leaving families distressed and uncertain about their future.

In this time of hardship, Alliance Bank Malaysia Berhad (ABMB or The Bank) and Alliance Islamic Bank Berhad (AIS), and the Malaysian Relief Agency are working hand in hand to provide life-saving assistance and long-term recovery support to the affected communities.As part of its commitment to stand with those in need, The Bank has begun mobilising initial support and funding since 19 September 2025.We now invite the public to be part of the Flood Relief Fundraising campaign to bring hope and ease the heavy burden faced by flood victims in Sabah.

 

We invite you to be part of this mission of compassion. Your contribution will support:

Immediate Relief

Dignity kits, baby kits, and food packs to meet urgent daily needs.

Recovery Assistance

Kitchen appliances and cleaning equipment to help families restore and rebuild their homes with dignity

 

Who Are The Beneficiaries?

Victims of Sabah Flood identified by Malaysian Relief Agency (MRA)

 

How Much Funds Have Been Raised:

RM150,000 has already been disbursed directly to MRA

 

With your support, we can help the people of Sabah regain safety and hope as they rebuild their lives. Even the smallest act of kindness can bring comfort.Please donate today and help us spread the word by sharing this campaign with your family and friends. The campaign runs from 24 October 2025 to 24 December 2025.

All donations above RM200 are eligible for tax exemption under LHDN Income Tax Act Section 44 (6). Donor must provide the required personal details while donating and claim before 31st December 2025.

progressText:
{"props":{"pageProps":{"status":true,"msg":"Campaign details","data":{"id":79013,"title":"Nourish Their Future — One Meal, Endless Hope","slug":"nourish-their-future-one-meal-endless-hope","cover_image":"https://admin.globalsadaqah.com/uploads/galleries/image_68f2325b2bda6_1760703067.png","cover_image_details":{"id":1975,"path":"uploads/galleries/image_68f2325b2bda6_1760703067.png","title":"5.png","description":"","caption":"","alt_text":""},"thumb_caption":"

No Child Should Learn on an Empty Stomach

","description":"

Key Campaign Points

  • Every RM5 fuels a refugee child’s education and health with one critical meal.
  • RM10 secures two life-saving meals, giving a child the strength to learn, grow, and dream.
  • Food is not just sustenance — it’s the foundation of stability, hope, and the chance for a better tomorrow.

Campaign Overview

The UAIM School, established in 2020 and officially endorsed by UNHCR, stands as a lifeline for 150 Rohingya refugee children in Malaysia.

For these children, the school is far more than classrooms and lessons — it is a safe haven where they are nurtured, protected, and most importantly, fed.

But today, this vital nourishment is under threat.

Global inflation has drastically driven up food costs, creating a critical shortfall in the school’s food budget. Without immediate support, we can no longer guarantee the daily meals that keep these children healthy and able to learn.

For families who are already struggling to survive, school meals are often the only nutritious food their children receive each day. No child should have to learn on an empty stomach.

 

Beneficiaries

  • Rohingya refugee children living in Malaysia
  • 150 students currently enrolled at UAIM School
  • Children relying on daily school meals as their only stable source of nutrition

 

Funds to Be Used For

All donations will go directly to:

  • Purchasing essential food ingredients
  • Preparing and serving 9,000 nutritious meals per month
  • Ensuring daily nourishment for 150 children

 

Hunger can’t wait.
Each ringgit brings warmth, hope, and the strength to learn.

Donate now and help us keep their plates — and their dreams — full.

RM5 = 1 meal. RM10 = 2 meals.
Together, we can nourish their future.

{"props":{"pageProps":{"status":true,"msg":"Campaign details","data":{"id":79011,"title":"Emergency Relief for the Gaza Strip: Delivering Life-Saving Aid","slug":"emergency-relief-for-the-gaza-strip-delivering-life-saving-aid","cover_image":"https://admin.globalsadaqah.com/uploads/galleries/image_68ef4a2345b97_1760512547.png","cover_image_details":{"id":1973,"path":"uploads/galleries/image_68ef4a2345b97_1760512547.png","title":"6.png","description":"","caption":"","alt_text":""},"thumb_caption":"

Together for the Gaza Strip: Food, Shelter and Hope

","description":"

Key Campaign Points

  • Food Aid: Trucks carrying food baskets and flour to support thousands of families facing hunger.
  • Water & Shelter: Supply of clean water, waterproof tarpaulins, tents, caravans, and restroom units for displaced families.
  • Winter Relief: Mattresses, blankets, pillows, and warm clothing to help families cope with harsh weather conditions.
  • Hygiene & Dignity Kits: Hygiene packs, baby care kits, women’s dignity kits, and elderly support kits.
  • Medical Aid: Urgent medicines, medical tools, and ambulance support to hospitals in Gaza.
  • Beneficiaries: Thousands of families, patients, women, children, and elderly affected by the ongoing crisis.
  • Supply Route: Direct delivery from Egypt to Gaza for faster and more efficient distribution.

 

Campaign Overview

The Gaza Strip is facing one of the worst humanitarian crises in recent history. In addition to the complete interruption of electricity, water, and communications, thousands of homes, hospitals, schools, and government buildings have been destroyed. Families are not just losing their homes — they are losing their safety, their livelihoods, and their hope.

More than 41,000 lives have been lost, with women and children making up a large portion of the victims. Over 1.9 million people are displaced, many living in overcrowded shelters or under makeshift coverings, exposed to the cold and rain. Famine and disease are already claiming lives, and clean water is almost non-existent. Hospitals are overwhelmed, treating patients on the floor without proper equipment.

The economic collapse has stripped 70% of the population of their main source of income, leaving parents unable to feed their children. With winter approaching, the situation is becoming even more desperate.

This campaign is an urgent, coordinated response to deliver life-saving humanitarian relief from Egypt to Gaza. The aid convoy includes food baskets and flour for 990 affected families, specialized waterproof tarpaulins for 6,000 displaced families, as well as medical supplies, hygiene kits, and winter clothing.

Every truck is a lifeline — a message of solidarity and hope. The need is immediate. The suffering is immense. Together, we can help families in Gaza survive this crisis with dignity and strength.

Is Finally Entering Gaza!"},"update_context":{"en":"

Assalamualaikum,

This Friday is not just another day — it’s a moment of hope.

The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Whoever feeds a hungry believer, Allah will feed him from the fruits of Jannah on the Day of Resurrection. Whoever gives water to a thirsty believer, Allah will give him to drink from the sealed nectar.”

 

With the help of our on-the-ground partners, families in Gaza are finally receiving clean, fresh water after weeks of enduring thirst and hardship:

 

  • 12,000 liters were distributed in Northern Gaza
  • 12,000 liters in Southern Gaza
  • 600 portions of eggplant hot meals were distributed
  • A total of 1,520 individuals benefited from the hot meal distributions, including pasta and eggplant dishes

 

Link to see the images :

  • https://ibb.co.com/album/HTHMw2 (Water Distributions At Southern Gaza)
  • https://ibb.co.com/album/p0L3PV (Water Distributions At Northern Gaza)
    https://ibb.co.com/album/svZQ25 (Hot Meals Distributions)

Link to see the videos :

  • https://youtu.be/JfC_2KFacuk (Water Distributions At Southern Gaza)
  • https://youtu.be/12g02p18570 (Water Distributions At Northern Gaza)
  • https://youtu.be/yUaz-7FympQ (Hot Meals Distributions)

 

And this is only the beginning. Our emergency convoy from Egypt is on the way with food for 990 families, tarpaulins for 6,000 displaced families, and critical medical and winter supplies.

With more than 41,000 lives lost, 1.9 million people displaced, and 70% of the population without income, every drop and every act of giving matters more than ever. You can see the updates of the past distributions on our campaign pages.

 

On this blessed day of Friday, let’s not just watch — let’s be part of the hope reaching Gaza.

 

Wassalamualaikum,

 

Global Sadaqah Team

Assalamualaikum,

 

The ceasefire in Gaza is quite shaky, but aid trucks are still managing to get in. Alhamdulilah, our trucks have also entered Gaza - bringing hope, water, and warmth to families who had almost nothing left!

 

Across Gaza, families are fighting to meet their most basic needs, and your support has reached them just in time.

  • 1. 27,000 liters of fresh water were distributed in Khan Younis, bringing relief to 1,450 families — around 8,700 peoplewho had endured days without safe water.
  • 2. Warm vegetable soup and fresh bread bundles filled empty stomachs, reaching 557 families — approximately 3,342 lives touched.
  • 3. 20 shopping vouchers through the 4epay platform supported 120 people with a month’s worth of essential needs — giving them the freedom to choose what their families truly need.

 

Here are the links to view the images :

  • https://ibb.co.com/album/h180mC (Distribution of hot meals)
  • https://ibb.co.com/album/Scxywq (Distribution of Fresh Waters)
  • https://ibb.co.com/album/qBPd3b (Distribution of Vouchers)

Here are the links to see the videos :

  • https://youtu.be/y7pyWr8m2pw (Distribution of hot meals)
  • https://youtu.be/fVWL5NK5nw4 (Distribution of Fresh Waters)
  • https://youtu.be/ohWyOdhRmG8 (Distribution of Vouchers)

These are not just numbers.
They are stories of survival, strength, and humanity — made possible through your giving.

The need remains urgent.

Let’s keep hope alive — one meal, one drop, one family at a time.

 

Wassalamualaikum,

GlobalSadaqah Team

{"props":{"pageProps":{"status":true,"msg":"Campaign details","data":{"id":79010,"title":"Help a Single Mother Pay Off Her Debt and Avoid Prison","slug":"help-a-single-mother-pay-off-her-debt-and-avoid-prison","cover_image":"https://admin.globalsadaqah.com/uploads/galleries/image_68db6cc0dfe6a_1759210688.png","cover_image_details":{"id":1963,"path":"uploads/galleries/image_68db6cc0dfe6a_1759210688.png","title":"39.png","description":"","caption":"","alt_text":""},"thumb_caption":"

Help a single mother to pay off her debt and avoid Prison.

","description":"

Key Campaigns

  • Sister reverted to Islam and her daughters soon followed her in accepting Islam.
  • Her husband was not faithful in marriage, abusive, and was consulting magicians.
  • She took divorce and custody through court but the legal charges were very high.
  • She has managed to pay around 70% of the huge fees. She also has 3 months’ rent overdue.
  • She is unable to pay the remaining amount (RM 15,760) and has started receiving legal notices from the lawyer’s office.
  • She is being threatened with jail time and the selling of her assets to recover the remaining amount.
  • She has paid 70% of the dues but still has to pay off RM 15,760.
  • We want to add another RM 2,000 to support her while she stabilises her life.

The Campaign Overview

In 2021, a woman in Gaborone embraced Islam, and soon after, her two daughters also followed her footsteps into the faith. But her journey was far from easy. Her husband not only rejected Islam, but also became abusive—physically and emotionally. He was unfaithful, and even turned to magicians, making the home a place of harm instead of safety.

This sister could not remain in such an environment. With courage, she sought a divorce and fought for custody of her daughters. By Allah’s mercy, she won both. But the cost of freedom came with an unbearable financial burden—massive legal fees, along with overdue rent.

Despite the immense hardship of raising two children alone, she has managed to pay 70% of the fees. She often went without food, struggling to balance daily survival and debt repayment. Now, RM 15,760 still remains, and the lawyers’ office has begun sending legal notices. They are threatening prison or the sale of her few assets.

If she is jailed, her daughters will be left without their mother. If her home is taken, they will be homeless. This is the heavy price she must pay simply for leaving an abusive marriage and protecting her faith.

With our help, she can preserve her dignity, keep her children safe, and rebuild her life with stability.

Who are the Beneficiaries

  • A revert sister who bravely left an abusive marriage for the sake of her faith and dignity.
  • Her two young daughters, who rely on their mother for protection, care, and a stable home.

What the Funds Will Be Used For

  • RM 15,760 to settle her remaining debt with the lawyer and pay overdue rent.
  • An additional RM 2,000 as a small cushion to help her stabilize while An-Nadaa arranges employment or a business opportunity for her.
  • Your contribution will directly help her clear this debt, avoid imprisonment, and secure a roof over her children’s heads.

Call to Action (CTA)

This is not just about paying off a debt—it’s about saving a mother from prison, protecting two daughters from homelessness, and giving a family the chance to live with dignity.

Support this revert sister today. Together, we can lift this heavy burden and help her build a new chapter of hope and stability.

Help Protect the People. Preserve Al-Aqsa.

The people of Jerusalem are not just enduring occupation — they are enduring erasure.

Day by day, the pressure mounts: homes demolished, livelihoods strangled, access to Al-Aqsa restricted — all in a calculated attempt to drive them away.

But they refuse to leave.
They stay, they struggle, they pray.
And today, they need you to stand with them.

Your donation is more than aid — it’s resistance. It’s a lifeline of hope.


Through this campaign, you’ll be part of a mission to help Jerusalem’s families hold their ground and preserve the identity of Islam’s third-holiest site.

Who You're Helping:
- Steadfast families defending their homes and history. 
- Orphans who’ve lost everything but their faith. 
- Students seeking knowledge under siege. 
- Worshippers clinging to Al-Aqsa with courage and du‘a

Every donation helps keep Al-Aqsa alive with voices, footsteps, and prayers.

Help Quench Gaza's Thirst!

","description":"

Key Points:

  • Severe Water Crisis: Gaza's 17-year blockade has led to a catastrophic water crisis, with only 4.74 liters of water available per person per day since October 7, 2023.
  • Destruction of Infrastructure: The destruction of wells and desalination plants has left large areas, including Gaza City and Khan Yunis, without safe water, worsening an already dire situation.
  • Urgent Campaign: The campaign aims to raise $44,220 (MYR 193, 530)  to provide 8,000-liter water tanks to displaced families in camps, ensuring access to essential drinking water, cooking, and hygiene.

In Phase 1, thanks to your support, we were able to:

  • Distribute 5,397 liters of clean water, easing the suffering of families who often go days without safe drinking water.
  • Construct 4 new wells, expanding access to clean water in areas where scarcity is a daily challenge.
  • Repair and rehabilitate 5 wells, restoring vital water supplies to vulnerable neighborhoods.

Now, in Phase 2, our focus is on displaced families living in camps and tents, where the need is most urgent. These families, already struggling to meet their most basic needs, are in desperate need of safe and reliable access to water.

We are urgently seeking to raise USD 44,220 (MYR 193,530) to provide 8,000-liter water tanks across six camps. These tanks will ensure families have access to clean water for drinking, cooking, and hygiene—bringing dignity and relief to thousands in crisis.

With your help, each tank will become a lifeline, giving families not just water, but a chance at survival amidst the ongoing devastation. Join us in Phase 2 of this campaign and make a tangible difference for the people of Gaza.

Each of these milestones is not just a number — it is a story of survival, of families finding relief, and of prayers whispered for those who made it possible.


Images and video links are available with every update items above, so you can witness the real impact of your giving.

 

But the journey is far from over. Gaza continues to bleed, and every meal, every drop of water, and every act of compassion matters.

Continue your sadaqah today, and let your giving be the lifeline for tomorrow.

 

Wassalamualaikum,

 

Global Sadaqah Team

 

"},"date":"2025-09-02"},{"id":264,"update_title":{"en":"Finally, Clean Water Has Reached Families in Gaza!"},"update_context":{"en":"

Assalamualaikum,

After weeks of thirst and uncertainty, families in Gaza finally received something so simple — yet so life-saving: clean water.

Thanks to your generosity, our partner’s clean water truck has successfully reached communities on the ground.

* 12,000 liters of clean water were distributed in Northern Gaza
* 12,000 liters of clean water were distributed in Southern Gaza

For families who’ve been struggling to access even a sip of clean water, this is more than just a delivery. It’s hope. It’s relief. It’s life.

And as the Prophet ﷺ reminded us, “The best charity is giving water to drink.” — Prophet Muhammad (Hadith)

The need is far from over. More families are still waiting. Every drop counts, and your continued support keeps the water flowing.

Thank you for being part of this lifesaving effort.

Wassalamualaikum,

Global Sadaqah Team

Assalamualaikum,

 

The ceasefire in Gaza is quite shaky, but aid trucks are still managing to get in. Alhamdulilah, our trucks have also entered Gaza - bringing hope, water, and warmth to families who had almost nothing left!

 

Across Gaza, families are fighting to meet their most basic needs, and your support has reached them just in time.

  • 1. 27,000 liters of fresh water were distributed in Khan Younis, bringing relief to 1,450 families — around 8,700 peoplewho had endured days without safe water.
  • 2. Warm vegetable soup and fresh bread bundles filled empty stomachs, reaching 557 families — approximately 3,342 lives touched.
  • 3. 20 shopping vouchers through the 4epay platform supported 120 people with a month’s worth of essential needs — giving them the freedom to choose what their families truly need.

 

Here are the links to view the images :

  • https://ibb.co.com/album/h180mC (Distribution of hot meals)
  • https://ibb.co.com/album/Scxywq (Distribution of Fresh Waters)
  • https://ibb.co.com/album/qBPd3b (Distribution of Vouchers)

Here are the links to see the videos :

  • https://youtu.be/y7pyWr8m2pw (Distribution of hot meals)
  • https://youtu.be/fVWL5NK5nw4 (Distribution of Fresh Waters)
  • https://youtu.be/ohWyOdhRmG8 (Distribution of Vouchers)

These are not just numbers.
They are stories of survival, strength, and humanity — made possible through your giving.

The need remains urgent.

Let’s keep hope alive — one meal, one drop, one family at a time.

 

Wassalamualaikum,

GlobalSadaqah Team

Healing their bodies and hearts

","description":"

Key Points:

  • This campaigns aims to provide medical examination and treatment for 3,000 displaced and wounded people located in 10 centres in the Gaza Strip
  • This is Phase 1 of 3 of the project
  • Each centre will be provided with a medical and nursing team providing medicine and medical spare parts for the wounded

Campaign Story:

This campaign aims to provide urgent medical examination and treatment for 3,000 displaced and wounded people across 10 centres in the Gaza Strip. Each centre will be supported with medical and nursing teams, along with essential medicines and spare parts for life-saving equipment. This is Phase 2 of 3 of our medical relief project.

In the previous phase, during the months of July and August, we were able to deliver vital humanitarian support to displaced and affected families in Gaza. With your continued generosity, thousands received relief and dignity at a time they needed it most. Importantly, 3 health centers were renovated and maintained, ensuring the continuity of essential medical services for communities under immense strain.

Now, as the crisis deepens, our focus turns to expanding this impact by equipping more centres with the staff, medicines, and resources they need to treat thousands of injured and displaced patients.

Your support will directly strengthen Gaza’s fragile healthcare system at a time when every single intervention counts. Together, we can continue to ease suffering and bring hope where it is most needed.

Gaza’s Hospital in Crisis Needs Us Now!
 
Assalamualaikum,
 
Alhamdulillah, our Mobile Clinic in Gaza continues to reach hundreds of people every day — providing urgent medical care to families who can no longer access hospitals safely.
 
With the support of our strategic partner on the ground, we’ve extended this mission to the Dialysis Department at Al-Aqsa Martyrs Hospital — a critical lifeline for patients in need of daily treatment.
 
Every day, 350–400 patients receive care. We are now working to restore dignity and comfort inside the hospital through:
 
- Repainting 105.34 m² of the department
- Installing 5 electric ventilation fans
- Installing 40 lighting lamps
- Supplying 12 waiting chairs
 
These aren’t just facility upgrades — they are small acts of mercy, restoring relief and hope in a place where healing can’t wait.
 
See the impact of your support:
 
- Photo documentation: https://ibb.co.com/album/Ps1nHP
- Video update: https://youtu.be/IVxthwZWxFY?si=EEsxUtrBWjVZQ-S7
 
Be part of this urgent mission. Your support today helps us reach one more patient tomorrow.
 
Stand with Gaza’s patients now:
https://globalsadaqah.com/campaigns/mobile-clinic-project-in-gaza-2024-phase-2

Wassalamualaikum,
 
Globalsadaqah Team

Paying Zakat to the Poorest Families in Northern Nigeria

","description":"

Key Points

  • Nigeria is a country where almost 80% of the population earn less than $2 a day
  • Our 2.5% is someone’s 100%
  • An-Nadaa Educational Foundation is working on the ground directly to make sure that your zakat reaches verified individuals in the form of cash
  • An-Nadaa operates under the guidance of Sheikh Ibrahim Nuhu (Madinah) and are very strict when it comes to the distribution of zakat funds

Campaign Story

Nigeria is a country where almost 80% of the population earn less than $2 a day and over 40% of children do not have access to primary education. In the rural communities of Northern Nigeria, roughly 60 million people live in extreme poverty and there is difficulty to attain even the basic of necessities.

Alhamdulillah, after successfully completing three phases of our Zakat drive in Nigeria — raising nearly a million ringgit for poor families — we’re now launching Phase 4. InshaAllah, together we can raise even more and change lives.

Zakat is the third of the five pillars of Islam. It is an obligation on all Muslims who meet the requirements. Zakat was legislated in 2 AH, approximately 18 months after the arrival of the Prophet ﷺ to Madinah.

The word Zakat occurs in the Quran thirty times. In twenty-seven of them it is associated with prayers in the same verse. In one place it is mentioned with prayers in the same sequence of verses, this is, 'those who humble themselves in their prayers' and 'who are active indeed in zakat.' This shows that zakat is second only to Salah in terms of importance for a Muslim.

A question that is often asked, 'I give a lot of charity throughout the year, then why do I still have to pay zakat?' Zakat is a pillar of Islam and it is an obligation on every Muslim that meets its requirements. This obligation cannot be offset by the normal charity. A person is rewarded for his generosity, but this obligation needs to be carried out irrespective of the amount of charity that is given provided certain conditions are met.

Remember, we cannot delay paying zakat as it is the right or trust of the poor that we have in our custody. This is actually how we should look at zakat. It is the money of the poor that Allah is channelling through us. It wasn’t ours such that we dictate how it is to be used etc. Add to that, another angle that we can look at is that our 2.5% is someone’s 100%.

Allah tells us, “In their wealth and properties is the right of the poor, the beggar and he who is in deprivation.” [Surah al-Dhariyat, 19]

Keeping this importance in mind, An-Nadaa Educational Foundation is working on the ground directly to make sure that your zakat reaches verified individuals in the form of cash. An-Nadaa operates under the guidance of Sheikh Ibrahim Nuhu (Madinah) and are very strict when it comes to the distribution of zakat funds. This is Phase 2 of this campaign to give Zakat in cash to the Asnaf.

The beneficiaries include: 

- Sick who cannot afford hospitals or any form of medical aid.

- Widows and orphans

- Families in extreme poverty

- Duat that are sent to neighbouring villages to teach the people. These duat are also from poor families

Each beneficiary is carefully vetted and verified by the team on the ground that is connected to the local community. In addition, the team uses the help of local imams and schools to identify and confirm families are in need and are to be included as part of the food distribution drive. This strict verification procedure makes sure that your zakat reaches those who really need it and are eligible to receive it.

Sheikh Ibrahim Nuhu said, 'The recipe for success is to look forward to paying our Zakah and to be in the first rows of the Masjid just like we look forward to breaking our fasts on a hot day.'

Empower Her Hustle: Digitising Dreams, Sustaining Livelihoods

 

","description":"

Key Points:

  • Equipping B40 women entrepreneurs with essential digital and business skills.
  • Launching a halal eCommerce hub to help them reach wider markets online.
  • Providing micro-seed sponsorships to kickstart their digital transformation.
  • Building community support systems through Mosafer’s KOMUNE and CAMPUS platforms.
  • Creating a zakat-eligible, scalable model of women-led digital empowerment.
  • This campaign is zakat-eligible.

Campaign Story:

In the heart of Malaysia’s B40 communities, women are rising early to prepare trays of kuih, managing food stalls under the blazing sun, and juggling home-based catering orders—all while caring for their families. These women are the quiet engines powering our local economies. But while their hearts are strong, their businesses face steep uphill battles.

In today’s digital-first world, the lack of digital skills, tools, and platforms means their passion often stalls before it can take off. Many of them cannot access eCommerce, don’t know how to market online, and are left behind in Malaysia’s booming digital economy.

That’s where the Mosafer Sustainable Living Launchpad for Community (LLC) comes in. With your support, we can empower these women with practical digital training, eCommerce access, and micro-seed capital to grow their businesses sustainably—right from their kitchens.

Together with USAHANITA WP Kuala Lumpur, we aim to create a replicable model of women-led, zakat-eligible digital entrepreneurship for long-term impact.

","description":"

Key Points:

  • Up to 1000 Quran donors have the unique opportunity to gift a Quran as a waqf to be placed inside Masjid al-Haram.
  • 1 Quran (Green - 14x20 - Normal Size) - MYR 85
  • 1 Quran (Blue - 20x29 - Large Size) - MYR 100
  • Every time that someone reads from your gifted copy, you get a reward for that, and that reward is further multiplied because of the blessed location.
  • This is Phase 08 of our Quran Waqf Project.

 

The Campaign

More than 13.5 million Muslims performed Umrah in 2023 alone. Imagine if even a quarter of them—over 3 million people—held the Quran you donated in Masjid al-Haram, reciting its verses in worship. Each word they recite becomes a light in their hearts and an unending stream of blessings for your soul.

By donating a Quran through this campaign, you’re placing a copy directly into the hands of these worshippers in one of Islam’s holiest sites.

Every verse recited from your gifted Quran not only nourishes the soul of the reader but also multiplies your rewards. The Prophet Muhammad (ﷺ) said:
“Whoever recites a letter from the Book of Allah, he will receive one good deed as ten good deeds like it. I do not say that Alif Lam Mim is one letter, but rather Alif is a letter, Lam is a letter, and Mim is a letter.” [Sunan al-Tirmidhī]

Through our trusted partners, Dawah Corner Bookstore (DCB), and the Official Mushaf Management body of Masjid al-Haram, we ensure that every Quran follows strict protocols for placement in the Blessed Masjid. Unlike unauthorized copies that may be removed, your donation is officially approved and remains accessible for years to come.

Alhamdulillah, here’s the latest update for the distributions (Phase 7):

  • Mushaf (Blue, Large): 8 copies
  • Mushaf (Green, Medium): 13 copies

Consider this: with millions visiting Masjid al-Haram annually, your single donation has the potential to transform countless lives, guiding hearts closer to Allah.

The Prophet (ﷺ) also said:
“Whoever guides someone to goodness will have a reward like one who did it.” [Ṣahih Muslim]

 

You wish to make a manual donation, please find the details below:

Bring Hope to Flood Victims

","description":"

Key Campaign Points

• The Northeast Monsoon has begun, bringing heavy continuous rainfall across Malaysia
• Forecast predicts 7–10 episodes of prolonged rain in the coming weeks
• Rivers are overflowing, roads are flooded, and homes in low-lying areas are at high risk
• Many communities are now cut off from food, clean water, and hygiene essentials
• Immediate humanitarian assistance is urgently needed
• ILTIZAM Relief Society is actively mobilising emergency aid including food baskets, hygiene kits, baby items, blankets, and first-aid essentials

Campaign Overview

The Northeast Monsoon has triggered widespread flooding across several regions in Malaysia, placing thousands of families in extremely challenging situations. Many were forced to evacuate their homes with minimal belongings as floodwaters rise rapidly. Beyond property damage, floods pose serious health and safety risks due to limited access to clean water, proper hygiene, and medical needs.

ILTIZAM Relief Society is on standby and fully prepared to deliver emergency relief to affected areas. Our teams are committed to ensuring that families receive the urgent support they need to stay safe and maintain dignity throughout this season.

Who Are the Beneficiaries

• Flood-displaced families and evacuees
• Low-income communities in flood-prone areas
• Children, babies, and elderly individuals requiring special care
• Individuals lacking access to food, clean water, and hygiene supplies
• Communities isolated due to blocked roads or damaged infrastructure

Act now! help deliver emergency relief before more families lose everything.
Your contribution can provide life-saving essentials such as food baskets, hygiene kits, blankets, baby diapers, and first-aid supplies.

Donate today and help lighten the burden of flood-affected families.
Every ringgit matters. Every minute counts. Together, we protect those in need.

25 Year Water Project: Building Wells for Poor Families in Bangladesh

","description":"

Key Points

  • Cost of 1 Well = MYR 1550 (USD 371)
  • Over 4.9 million people in Bangladesh still do not have clean water close to home.
  • Over 73 million people in Bangladesh – two in five – use contaminated water.
  • Over 1,000+ children under 5 die from diarrhoea each year. This is primarily caused by dirty water and poor toilets. 
  • Donations to this campaign will be used to build wells that give access to safe drinking water, improved sanitation, and hygiene practices for poor families in Bangladesh.

Campaign Story

Bangladesh is the eighth-most populous country in the world, with a population of over 164 million. Despite such a large number, major parts of the country don't have the ability to access clean drinking water and even today, many drink water from sources that are extremely unhygienic.

Over 4.9 million people in Bangladesh still do not have clean water close to home. Over 73 million people in Bangladesh – two in five – use contaminated water. Over 1,000+ children under 5 die from diarrhoea each year. This is primarily caused by dirty water and poor toilets. 

This is Phase 3 of the water well project in Bangladesh. Alhamdulillah, AlKhairi has already built over 70 water wells in Phase 1 & Phase 2. The wells aim to provide a family access to clean drinking water for cooking, washing, and most importantly, drinking.

This campaign focuses on providing water wells across rural villages in Bangladesh, along with periodic maintenance to ensure the well is properly maintained for the use of the communities. The water well is guaranteed to last 25 years, and it can serve multiple family generations, InshaAllah. 

Donations to this campaign will be used to build wells that give access to safe drinking water, improved sanitation, and hygiene practices for poor families in Bangladesh.   Let us come together and help the poor and underprivileged in Bangladesh with the gift of water.

Just RM10 can go a long way in changing their lives and bringing smiles to their faces. We invite people to donate as a family, so it is as though your family is giving a gift of a well to another poor family in Bangladesh.


Sa’ad ibn Ubadah asked the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, “Which charity is best?” The Prophet ﷺ said, “A drink of water.” 
The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, “When a man dies, his deeds come to an end except for three things: Sadaqah Jariyah (ceaseless charity); a knowledge which is beneficial, or a virtuous descendant who prays for him.” [Muslim]

Even if you cannot sponsor an entire well, your donations will be used to support the existing wells and help in their maintenance.

Bank Name: Affin Bank
Name: Berrypay (M) Sdn Bhd
Account: 109920481671

Reference: KBD Well

BerryPay is our official payment gateway.

If you have made a direct bank transfer, please send your transfer proof to hello@globalsadaqah.com
