Alhamdulillah, we have successfully completed 19 wells and have 10 wells currently in progress, bringing the total to 29 wells. These wells provide clean and safe drinking water to rural villages in Bangladesh, where millions still rely on contaminated sources. Each well is built to last up to 25 years, serving multiple generations, inshaAllah. Your support is helping us combat waterborne diseases, reduce child mortality, and bring life-changing access to clean water for entire communities.

"},"date":"2025-08-14"},{"id":270,"update_title":{"en":"The Gift of Life, Built by You!"},"update_context":{"en":"

Assalamualaikum,

In a country where over 73 million people still use contaminated water, and where countless children under the age of five are tragically lost each year due to waterborne diseases, your donation is a direct lifeline. It’s not just a well; it is a permanent source of health, dignity, and a future for an entire family. This precious gift of clean water will now serve multiple generations for the guaranteed period of 25 years, InshaAllah.

These two wells were part of our August Collection efforts, and we are honored to announce they have been completed:

  • Well 1 (Dedicated to Q1): Ordered September 12, 2025, and Completed October 22, 2025.
  • Well 2 (Dedicated to Abdul Rahman Bin Mahbob): Ordered September 12, 2025, and Completed October 22, 2025.

Link to see the images :

  • https://ibb.co.com/album/bH8v6q (Q1)
  • https://ibb.co.com/album/gSTTHP (Abdul Rahman Bin Mahbob)

Link to see videos :

  • https://youtu.be/EqhJe9mTiso (Q1)
  • https://youtu.be/S2Kzr_auvJU (Abdul Rahman Bin Mahbob)


Watching the joy on the faces of the families as they draw their first clean, clear cup of water—water for drinking, cooking, and washing—is the most powerful reminder of why we do this. You didn't just donate RM10; you restored hope and wiped away fear.

We extend our sincere thanks to the entire team on the ground for their dedication in building these wells and bringing this vision to life. We are grateful for your trust in Global Sadaqah to be the channel for your Sadaqah. May your sustenance and blessings continue to increase abundantly.

On behalf of the families in Bangladesh who now have access to safe drinking water: Thank you. May Allah (SWT) continuously increase your sustenance and bless you and your family for giving the most essential gift of all—the gift of water.

 

With deep appreciation,

GlobalSadaqah Team

{"props":{"pageProps":{"status":true,"msg":"Campaign details","data":{"id":79009,"title":"A New Block for a Brighter Tomorrow","slug":"a-new-block-for-a-brighter-tomorrow","cover_image":"https://admin.globalsadaqah.com/uploads/galleries/image_68d4b7d2b7cda_1758771154.jpg","cover_image_details":{"id":1959,"path":"uploads/galleries/image_68d4b7d2b7cda_1758771154.jpg","title":"35.jpg","description":"","caption":"","alt_text":""},"thumb_caption":"

Your Support Turns Classrooms into Futures

 

","description":"

1. Key Campaign

  • GIIA is a Waqf School – all surplus revenue supports An-Nadaa’s welfare, dawah, and operational expenses
  • This expansion is not just one project – success here will enable many future sadaqah jariyah initiatives
  • A new 3-floor block with 30 classrooms is almost complete and needs furniture & equipment
  • Each classroom will be equipped with whiteboards, computers, and projectors to enhance teaching outcomes
  • GIIA is run under the supervision and guidance of Sheikh Ibrahim Nuhu Tahir

2. The Campaign (Overview)

An-Nadaa is expanding its GIIA school with a new 30-classroom block. Construction is nearly complete, but furniture and equipment are urgently needed to begin using these classrooms.

GIIA is not an ordinary school. Unlike typical institutions that focus only on passing exams, GIIA nurtures students through a balanced integration of Islamic knowledge and modern education. Its goal is to raise leaders who are deeply connected with the Qur’an while excelling in worldly sciences, languages, and practical skills.

At GIIA, students will:

  • Memorize the Qur’an within six years
  • Be fluent in Arabic and English
  • Have a strong foundation in Islamic knowledge
  • Excel in math, science, and other academic subjects
  • Meet role models such as scholars, professionals, and community leaders
  • Gain IT skills, vocational training, and exposure to real-world responsibilities

 

The new block will:

  • Allow hundreds of new students to enroll, many of whom were previously turned away due to lack of space
  • Enable the school to extend higher classes that were not possible before
  • Generate increased revenue to sustain An-Nadaa’s welfare and dawah work, multiplying the sadaqah jariyah impact

 

3. Who is the Beneficiary?

  • Direct beneficiary: GIIA School through the new equipment
  • Students: Benefit from improved teaching tools and visual learning methods
  • Community: Gains future leaders nurtured both Islamically and academically
  • Donors: Benefit with ongoing sadaqah jariyah rewards from every act of learning, dawah, and halal livelihood of these students

 

4. The Funds Will Be Used For

  • Purchase of whiteboards
  • Purchase of computers
  • Purchase of projectors
  • Installation and setup of classroom equipment

 

Help us furnish the future of our children. By equipping these classrooms with the right tools, you will not only improve their learning today but also shape leaders who will serve Islam and the community tomorrow.

progressText:
{"props":{"pageProps":{"status":true,"msg":"Campaign details","data":{"id":78949,"title":"Striking a bond of love through food: Jalinan Kasih - Phase 2 (PEKAYATIM)","slug":"iidac-jalinan-kasih-2","cover_image":"https://admin.globalsadaqah.com/uploads/galleries/image_6787420b21bfc_1736917515.png","cover_image_details":{"id":1275,"path":"uploads/galleries/image_6787420b21bfc_1736917515.png","title":"8.png","description":null,"caption":null,"alt_text":null},"thumb_caption":"

Imagine Being Their Only Hope – Will You Step Up?

","description":"

Key Points:

  • This campaign is Zakat-eligible. An official receipt from the state religious authority of Perlis can be produced upon request.
  • Under the Jalinan Kasih initiative, 200 - 300 packs of food packs are given out daily to the needy, Muslims and non-Muslims alike.
  • IIDAC also runs street dawah programmes, mosque tours, skills training for reverts and more community-centred activities.
  • This is the second phase of the 'Striking a bond of love through food: Jalinan Kasih campaign'
The Campaign:

Imagine this:
 
You’re wandering the streets of Kota Bharu, Malaysia, a place filled with the hum of life. But hidden amidst the bustle are untold stories—families going to bed hungry, tourists stranded with no one to turn to, and reverts struggling to hold onto hope.
Now, imagine this:
 
A small team with big hearts steps in, ready to change everything. They hand out warm meals to anyone in need—Muslims and non-Muslims alike. But they don’t stop there. Every food pack offers a gentle reminder of Allah’s love, a message that nourishes not just the body but the soul.
 
This is Jalinan Kasih—the Bond of Love—an initiative of the International Islamic Information and Daawah Center (IIDAC) that has touched lives since 2002. And today, they need your support to keep going.

In Phase 1 of this campaign, with Allah’s blessings and your generosity, we successfully raised MYR 60,887, providing critical support to countless families, those who are in need, Muslims and non-Muslims. Yet, the mission is far from over. With many more lives to touch and needs to meet, we are launching Phase 2 of Jalinan Kasih, setting a target of MYR 100,000 to continue this vital work.
Why This Campaign?
 
  • A Daily Lifeline of Love and Unity: IIDAC provides 200–300 food packs every day in Kota Bharu to those who need it most—orphans, struggling families, the homeless, and even stranded tourists. Their approach transcends religion, offering aid to anyone in need.
  • Dawah Beyond Words: Every meal distributed comes with a heartfelt reminder about life, gratitude, and Allah’s mercy. It’s dawah in action—sharing Islam’s universal message of kindness and unity in the most relatable way.
  • Empowering Reverts and Strengthening Communities: Through skills training for reverts, mosque tours, and street dawah programs, IIDAC helps new Muslims navigate their faith journey while strengthening the bonds of the local community.
  • A Founder’s Legacy of Faith: Founded by Muhammad Michael bin Abdullah, a revert to Islam, IIDAC reflects his life’s mission: to share the beauty of Islam with sincerity and compassion. His vision has transformed the organization into a beacon of hope for all.
  • A Global Message of Compassion: Though based in Malaysia, IIDAC embodies Islam’s global message of mercy. Their work is a reminder that a single act of kindness—whether a meal, a smile, or a kind word—can ripple across borders and change lives
Today, you have the chance to bring light into someone’s life, food for the body and soul. Will you?

Empowering Quranic Education Access
 
","description":"

Key Points

  • Al Safa Academy provides crucial Quranic education for Palestinians
  • Donations needed to sustain operations and support teachers
  • Political and security challenges limit educational access

Campaign Story

In the West Bank and Gaza, traditional Quranic education is increasingly under threat, leaving many children without access to the foundational texts of their faith. Al Safa Academy addresses this need by providing Quranic education to over 1800 students, including Palestinian children both locally and globally, as well as other underprivileged children. The academy steps in as a crucial resource for these children, offering them the opportunity to learn and connect with their faith despite the political and security challenges in the region.

The political situation in the West Bank, including occupation since 1967 and divided governance between the Palestinian Authority and the occupiers, complicates access to religious education. Security concerns and restrictions on religious activities, including Quranic teaching in mosques, further limit educational opportunities for Palestinian children. These measures are often seen as attempts to control religious institutions and mitigate perceived nationalistic threats, impacting the ability of communities to maintain their religious and cultural practices.

Al Safa Academy's mission is vital not only for preserving Quranic education but also for supporting its teachers, many of whom are widows, handicapped individuals, or those facing difficult circumstances. By providing an online platform, the academy breaks down geographical and financial barriers, ensuring children from all walks of life can access Quranic knowledge. This approach empowers individuals and fosters a stronger connection to faith for children who might otherwise be deprived of this educational foundation.

To sustain its operations, Al Safa Academy relies on a combination of student fees and donations. However, with only a small number of students able to afford the monthly fee, the academy needs external support to continue its vital work. Donations help cover teacher salaries and operational costs, ensuring that the academy can provide free or low-cost education. Supporters are encouraged to contribute financially, spread the word, and consider recurring donations to help Al Safa Academy maintain its mission and keep the light of Quranic knowledge shining for deserving Palestinian children.

Let’s ease the suffering of the disabled in Gaza with the gift of movement

","description":"

Key Points

  • More than 2,500 wounded and ended up with mobility impairments due to constant attacks on Gaza Strip, latest being Sept 2022 and May 2021 war.
  • The cost of wheelchairs and medical supplies are a huge burden for the affected/wounded and with mobility impairments.
  • There is a severe shortage of wheelchairs and medical equipment from the Ministry of Health and the Rehabilitation Institutions.

Campaign Story

What is the campaign about?

  • Provide wheelchairs for the disabled and wounded in Gaza from wars in September 2022 and May 2021

What is special about it?

  • By enabling their mobility, they can be active and productive members of society
  • It will also build the trust between supporting institutions

Who are the beneficiaries of this campaign?
100 beneficiaries: (Jabalia City)
1. the wounded
2. the disabled

How will the raised funds help the beneficiaries?

  • Assist wounded and those with special needs in accepting and adapting their integration into the community.
  • Strengthen the rehabilitation service for the wounded and those with special needs by providing them with wheelchairs.
  • Alleviate the economic burden on the families of those wounded by providing them with free medical wheelchairs.
  • The wounded and those with special needs in wheelchairs are helpful for their mobility.
  • Strengthening trust between the wounded and the disabled on the one hand and supporting institutions on the other.

What are the plans for the beneficiaries:

  • Help the wounded overcome impairments enabling them to be active, participating, and productive members of society.
  • Share with other community health and rehabilitation programs and referral to a wheelchair service center where appropriate, and support the wounded and the disabled for follow-up, maintenance, and repair in the community.
  • Support accessibility, including the adaptation of the wounded’s environment such as wider doors and ramps.
  • Link with education, employment, and other key development sectors.

Don't miss out on this amazing opportunity to #CirculateGood - on a truly global level.

The next time you think of sadaqah, think global.

Yemen Needs You Now

","description":"

Key Points:

  • Critical Food Shortage: Over 20 million Yemenis face severe food insecurity, leading to widespread malnutrition, especially among children and vulnerable adults.
  • Goal to Support 1,000 Families: Albaraka Relief aims to raise RM150,000 to provide essential food supplies to at least 1,000 Yemeni families, offering a lifeline amidst the ongoing humanitarian crisis.

Campaign Story

Aid 4 Yemen: Your Support Can Save Lives

Yemen remains gripped by an ongoing humanitarian crisis, yet the world’s attention has all but turned away. At Albaraka Relief, we stay connected to the people of Yemen, who now face widespread malnutrition as over 20 million are deprived of adequate food. The impact is most severe on children, whose weakened immune systems leave them vulnerable to illness and malnutrition, while adults struggle with physical incapacity. Their suffering continues, but their voices remain unheard.

In response, Albaraka Relief is relaunching our Aid 4 Yemen initiative to provide critical food supplies. Our goal is to raise MYR150,000 to support 1,000 Yemeni families in need, giving them a lifeline amidst this growing crisis. Your donation can help alleviate their hardship and provide the nourishment they desperately need. Together, we can make a real difference.

{"props":{"pageProps":{"status":true,"msg":"Campaign details","data":{"id":78944,"title":"A Baby's Fight for Life: Your Help Could Make All the Difference","slug":"gw-save-baby-1","cover_image":"https://admin.globalsadaqah.com/uploads/galleries/image_66deb6a92b2c7_1725871785.jpg","cover_image_details":{"id":1191,"path":"uploads/galleries/image_66deb6a92b2c7_1725871785.jpg","title":"WhatsApp Image 2024-09-08 at 17.05.51_76d6d6a1.jpg","description":null,"caption":null,"alt_text":null},"thumb_caption":"

Support the journey of underserved children

","description":"

Key Points:

  • Babies Medical Struggles: Months year old babies, sometimes born prematurely, are suffering from significant medical challenges.
  • Financial Hardship & Limited Support: Their parents are in financial distress, seeking NGO assistance, and in some cases, awaiting a UNHCR card that may reduce the medical costs by 50%, but no help has arrived yet.
  • Call for Community Support: The campaign appeals for contributions to ease the families burden, enabling the babies discharge and ongoing recovery.

Campaign Story

Example of case:

Meet Cing Muan Niang, a mother whose journey has been marked by both the miracle of life and the trials of uncertainty. Four months ago, her beautiful baby boy came into this world prematurely at 30 weeks, weighing just 1.34kg. Born in Myanmar amidst difficult circumstances, the baby has bravely fought for his life every day since, and now, at 4 months old, weighs a healthy 4kg.

However, as this little one gets ready for discharge, the family faces a new challenge. The cost of medical care has accumulated to a total of RM25,000. With limited financial resources and ongoing paperwork for their UNHCR card, which could reduce their bill by 50%, they remain in desperate need of support. The parents have reached out to multiple NGOs for help, but so far, there has been no response.

Cing Muan Niang’s only hope now lies in the hands of the kind-hearted people who are willing to step forward. This baby has already overcome so much, and with your support, his family can focus on his recovery without the overwhelming burden of debt. Any contribution, no matter the size, will make a tangible difference in this family’s life.

Together, we can provide them with the assistance they need to start a new chapter. Will you join us in lifting the weight off their shoulders and giving this little one a better chance at life?

 

Update on Cing Muan Niang's baby: 

The baby was discharged on 18th September 2024 after receiving some funds from a few NGOs, alhamdulillah. 

 

Repurposing of campaign

We'd like to keep this campaign open to help other patients (young babies or children from underserved communities e.g. refugees with/out UNHCR cards) who suffer a similar fate. The funds collected in this campaign will be used to help the families.

Enabling The Gift Of Guidance

","description":"

Key Points:

  • Bridging Spiritual Gaps: The ThaiQuran initiative aims to address the scarcity of Thai-translated Qurans in Thailand, providing free Quran access for Thai Muslims.
  • Quality and Preservation: The campaign focuses on ensuring the durability and longevity of each Quran through high-quality printing, premium art paper, and Halal-certified materials. The goal is to create a lasting legacy of accessible Islamic education and spiritual enlightenment in Thailand.

Campaign Story

In the heart of Thailand, amid its rich cultural tapestry, the ThaiQuran initiative was born in 2020 as a response to a profound need. While countries with large Muslim populations had ample access to translated Qurans, Thai Muslims faced a significant challenge in finding copies in their native language.

This campaign seeks to bridge the spiritual gap by providing free, high-quality Thai-translated Qurans to every Muslim home in Thailand. Beyond translation, these Qurans incorporate innovative technology with QR codes linking to online resources, making the Quran accessible and engaging for all age groups.

Our goal is to raise a minimum of MYR 110,000 to further this noble mission. These funds will be allocated to printing and distributing Thai-translated Qurans, ensuring their quality and durability. Additionally, we aim to expand our digital integration, enriching the content linked to QR codes, including comprehensive Tafseer, audio recitations, and interactive learning modules.

With over 7.5 million Thai Muslims in Thailand, your contribution is not just a donation but a legacy that will echo through generations, lighting up lives with wisdom, providing spiritual solace, and nurturing a deeper understanding of Islam in Thailand.

Join us in this journey of faith, education, and empowerment, and be part of a movement that transcends boundaries and unites hearts. This is a fantastic opportunity to earn eternal rewards as your sadaqah jariyah in the Hereafter! Imagine the rewards of a person reciting each letter, also going to you.

The Prophet ﷺ said, “Whoever guides someone to goodness will have a reward like one who did it.” [Muslim]

The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "Whoever recites a letter from the Book of Allah, he will be credited with a good deed, and a good deed gets a ten-fold reward. I do not say that Alif-Lam-Mim is one letter, but Alif is a letter, Lam is a letter and Mim is a letter." [Tirmidhi]

{"props":{"pageProps":{"status":true,"msg":"Campaign details","data":{"id":78963,"title":"91% of Imams in Africa Can't Afford to Live: Your Zakah is Their Lifeline!","slug":"IDP-Imam-Assist","cover_image":"https://admin.globalsadaqah.com/uploads/galleries/image_67c5d31074b69_1741017872.png","cover_image_details":{"id":1471,"path":"uploads/galleries/image_67c5d31074b69_1741017872.png","title":"173.png","description":null,"caption":null,"alt_text":null},"thumb_caption":"

Let the Imams be Imams.

","description":"

Key Points

  • Many Imams across Africa earn only $30 a month, an extremely low salary, making survival difficult.
  • Imams serve as leaders, mentors, and caretakers but lack financial stability.
  • Many Imams struggle to meet basic needs; they are unable to pay school fees, afford transport, or repair homes.
  • The Imam Development Program bridges the income gap with a financial top-up of $120 / MYR535 a month that is spent on daily lifesaving essentials.
  • This enables Imams to support their families, educate their children, and serve effectively.
  • This financial relief helps Imams focus on leadership and uplifting their people.
  • This campaign is zakat-eligible.

Campaign Story

Picture this: You are the Imam of a Masjid in rural Malawi. You studied for 7 years under great scholars in South Africa. You are unapologetically passionate about Islam and preserving Islam. You have a beautiful family. A wife and three children. Your parents are your dependents too. Like every parent, you want nothing but the best for them. You are the community's hero. You are their leader. When they need support, there is no doubt who they will turn to. When they are hungry, you offer them everything you have. When a child becomes an orphan, you take them in. You are an Imam. You are the heir of the Prophet ﷺ to them. You know the responsibility is great.

Unfortunately, you only earn $30 a month.
$30 a month to take care of your every need. Your parents need. Your children's every need. Your community's every need. You live in one of the hungriest, poorest countries in the world. You are expected to be a pillar of strength, a guiding light, an advisor, a mentor, and a role model. 

You have lofty dreams and aspirations. You dream of completing a university degree, owning a means of transport, paying school fees on time, fixing your mother's house roof, beautifying your Madrassah with essentials like a chalkboard and charts, and most importantly, you dream of performing Hajj one day. 

Their expenses are far greater than their income. Sadly, Imams are not subject to salary increases or performance bonuses. They get what they get, and sadly, they don't have a say in it.

Solution: Monthly Assistance of $120 / MYR535

The Imam Development Program provides Imams from South Africa, Lesotho, Swaziland, Malawi, Zambia, Tanzania, Namibia, Botswana, Mozambique, Uganda, Kenya, Rwanda and Sierra Leone with a comprehensive package. The most important part of the package is the lifesaving monthly assistance of $120 / MYR535 as a top-up to their salaries.

This aims to provide vital support by bridging the gap in their income.

Clean water for needy in West Java countryside

","description":"

Key Points:

  • 33.4 million Indonesians lack clean water and access to proper sanitary facilities in the countryside.

Campaign Story

World Wild Life claims that 1.1 billion people worldwide lack access to water. Among many factors, the increasing number of expenses and the lack of financial power to build clean water facilities & infrastructure is a huge contributor to this number.
 
In our Islamic history, the issue with water also happened to the residents of Madinah during Prophet Muhammad's (ﷺ)  era. Finally, Uthman bin Affan used it as an opportunity to benefit the Ummah by helping to buy and donate the Raumah well.
 
Access to clean water is crucial as it affects all aspects of life, from health to people's welfare. Sadly, even after 1400 years since the issue with water access in Madinah, access to clean water is still an issue in Indonesia.
 
At the moment, there are 33.4 million Indonesians lacking clean water.
 
Not only access to clean water, but proper sanitary facilities are also quite rare in the Indonesian countryside. Given the distance from the city, the transporting cost becomes a burden on top of the high price of the materials.
 
With that, we are encouraging all to follow suit of what Uthman bin Affan did and provide easier access to clean water and proper sanitary facilities for the people in Indonesia.
 
Your contribution will surely change the life of the people.
 
Who are the beneficiaries of this campaign?
 
People who lack access to clean water in West Java, Indonesia. We have identified 1,881 people in the countryside of West Java in several villages.
 
The clean water infrastructure built from this fund will help the community improve their health and well-being. Water is a basic human need.
 
Funds will be distributed in 3 water programs for all. Wells, shared toilets, and pipelines, adapted to the needs of each village.
 
This construction infrastructure will involve local communities (beneficiaries). So that people have a sense of ownership of the facilities provided.
 
Beneficiaries will also be educated on how to manage the facility. Beneficiaries will also be motivated to build the same infrastructure in other villages.
 

Malaysia Bank Transfer

Bank Name: Affin Bank
Name: Berrypay (M) Sdn Bhd
Account: 109920205417
Reference: WS Water Java

BerryPay is our official payment gateway.

If you have made a direct bank transfer, please send your transfer proof to hello@globalsadaqah.com

{"props":{"pageProps":{"status":true,"msg":"Campaign details","data":{"id":24175,"title":"A Sip of Relief: Building A Solar Powered Water Pump in Yemen","slug":"yemen-solar","cover_image":"https://admin.globalsadaqah.com/uploads/campaign/cover_63a156d171928_1671517905.jpg","cover_image_details":null,"thumb_caption":"

A Sip of Relief: Building A Solar Powered Water Pump in Yemen

","description":"

Key Points

  • More than half of the population in Yemen do not have safe access to clean drinking water.
  • Beneficiaries of this campaign include internally displaced peoples (IDPs), host families and the poor and needy families.
  • Each water pump on an average can help alleviate the difficulties for almost 20,000 residents.
  • Donations to this campaign will be used to cover the well drilling process, installation of solar panel and also water distribution systems to the neighbourhood.

Campaign Story

Many areas in Yemen are facing famine-like conditions. This is forecasted to nearly triple in the first half of 2023. The Covid-19 pandemic has increased costs, made access to resources, and distribution of aid more difficult. 75% of the population or 22 million people are in need of some form of humanitarian assistance.  55% of the population or 16 million people do not have safe access to drinking water.

According to World Health Organization (WHO), the country has high rates of communicable diseases, limited access to routine immunization and health services for children and families, and inadequate sanitation as well as hygiene systems. The current conflict creates the world's worst humanitarian crisis. The war destroyed and caused damage to water infrastructures such as dams, reservoirs and water systems. Besides, the situation also contributes to poor health and high death rates because of a lack of access to safe and clean water.

Since 2018, 8 solar-powered water-pump projects have been implemented by MRA across 4 governorates in Yemen in collaboration with local NGOs and support from local MRA staff (Yemen office). This project had benefited more than 100,000 people including internally displaced peoples (IDPs), families and poor people. The solar-powered water-pump projects covered mosques, schools and public buildings including hospitals in the villages, IDPs camps and cities. Each water pump on average can help alleviate the difficulties for almost 20,000 residents. This project aims to lessen the suffering of Yemenis by providing clean water for daily needs and water supply for agricultural activities in the target locations.

The Solution

Donations to this campaign will be used to cover the well drilling process, installation of solar panels and also water distribution systems in the neighbourhood. The beneficiaries will get a supply of clean water for daily usage including drinking water and to support agricultural activities.

The cost includes:
- Solar panels (330 w): RM105,264
- Combiner box and inverter (30 kw): RM12,750
- Pump materials: RM3,440
- Earth system: RM4,300
- Connection cables between panels, inverter and combiner box: RM12,300
- Ground mount system: RM 26,316
- Transportation and installing the system: RM15,050
- Manpower: RM2,580
Cost: RM182,000
Administration Fee (11%): RM20,020
Total Cost: RM202,020

The solar-powered water-pump will be main source of clean water for daily use and agricultural activities which can help beneficiaries to improve their hygiene and sanitation. The key use will be to help the people irrigate their agricultural land and empower them.

Let us come together and help the poor and underprivileged in Yemen with the gift of water. Just RM10 can go a long way in changing their lives and bringing smiles to their faces. 

Sa’ad ibn Ubadah asked the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, “Which charity is best?” The Prophet ﷺ said, “A drink of water.”

The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, “When a man dies, his deeds come to an end except for three things: Sadaqah Jariyah (ceaseless charity); a knowledge which is beneficial, or a virtuous descendant who prays for him.” [Muslim]

  • Your donation funds sustainable clean water infrastructure in the worst-hit areas.

Campaign Story

In the flood-ravaged districts of Sindh, Pakistan — especially in areas like Shaheed Benazirabad — clean drinking water is not a guarantee.     In collaboration with the National Disability and Development Forum (NDF), IltiIltizamnt floodwater, or far-off sources. Women and girls often walk kilometres each day just to fill a single container, exposing themselves to harassment, heat, and physical strain.

 

But with your support, this can change.

In collaboration with the National Disability and Development Forum (NDF), Iltizam Relief Society is delivering sustainable, life-changing water solutions to these underserved communities — starting with clean water infrastructure where it’s needed most.


Your donations will fund:
🚰 Installation of clean water access points in strategic village locations

🌱 Development of sustainable infrastructure for long-term water security

 

Beneficiaries:

✅ Rural families in Shaheed Benazirabad and nearby district.

✅ Women and children who currently bear the burden of water collection

✅ People with disabilities who face added hardship during emergencies

✅ Communities still recovering from the devastating floods

progressText:
{"props":{"pageProps":{"status":true,"msg":"Campaign details","data":{"id":78988,"title":"Help Maintain al-Aqsa: Defend Its Sacred Identity","slug":"Stand-4-alAqsa-UW","cover_image":"https://admin.globalsadaqah.com/uploads/galleries/image_682146dc66a71_1747011292.png","cover_image_details":{"id":1792,"path":"uploads/galleries/image_682146dc66a71_1747011292.png","title":"404.png","description":null,"caption":null,"alt_text":null},"thumb_caption":"

Be a shield for Al-Aqsa

","description":"

Key Points:

  • Al-Aqsa faces an intensified effort to erase its Islamic identity
  • The war on Gaza is being used as cover to Judaize Al-Quds
  • Access to the mosque is being cut off; worshippers are being displaced
  • Ummet Waqf is actively running programs to keep Al-Aqsa alive
  • Every donation strengthens the spiritual and human presence inside the mosque
  • This campaign is zakat-eligible

Campaign Story:

The Most Dangerous Attempt to Erase Al-Aqsa’s Identity is Happening Now. Don’t Look Away!

At this very moment, Al-Masjid Al-Aqsa is facing one of the most serious and systematic threats in its history. While global attention is focused on the catastrophic war in Gaza, the occupation is quietly accelerating efforts to Judaize Al-Quds and Al-Aqsa — changing its landscape, restricting access, and forcibly removing Palestinians from their homes.

Their goal is clear: to strip Al-Aqsa of its Islamic identity and sever its connection to the Ummah. To leave it silent, empty, and forgotten. 

But we will not let that happen.

At Ummet Waqf, we are working on the ground to protect the mosque’s sanctity and presence through ongoing support projects inside Al-Aqsa. This includes not just worship, but education, cultural revival, and restoration — all of which are acts of resistance.

With your donation, we can continue to:
🕌 Run Qur’an memorisation circles and educational programs inside Al-Aqsa, keeping the knowledge of Islam alive at its very heart
🕌 Provide transportation to bring in worshippers from surrounding areas, especially those restricted from entering
🕌 Organise recreational and awareness activities for children, building a strong spiritual connection to the mosque from a young age
🕌 Support dedicated volunteer teams who guard, clean, and assist inside the mosque

As the gates of Al-Aqsa are being closed to its people, we must ensure the light of dhikr, knowledge, and presence inside it never dies out. Let your contribution be a shield for Al-Aqsa.

{"props":{"pageProps":{"status":true,"msg":"Campaign details","data":{"id":78874,"title":"Support the Medical Village for the needy in Lebanon","slug":"csm-mv-2","cover_image":"https://admin.globalsadaqah.com/uploads/campaign/cover_64d4b5b7666df_1691661751.jpg","cover_image_details":null,"thumb_caption":"

Support the underprivileged via the Medical Village

","description":"

Key Points:

  • Situation in Lebanon has gone from bad to worse, number of Syrian refugee families living below the poverty level rose from 89% in 2019 to 94% in 2020
  • 9 per 10 families are still burdened with debt due to insufficient basic needs
  • This Medical Village will support pregnant mothers and refugee children from Syria, Palestine as well as local Lebanese children

Campaign Story

Based on the Vulnerability of Assessment of Syrian Refugees (VASyR 2021) in Lebanon, economic collapse, inflation, the COVID-19 pandemic and also the explosion of Beirut port had given tremendous pressure on the Lebanese community including the Syrian refugees. These calamities have caused thousands of Lebanese families to plug into worse poverty. 

Among VASyR's concerns is the increase in the number of families living below the poverty level which is 94% in 2020 compared to 89% in the previous year which indirectly shows the predicament that Syrian refugees are currently experiencing.

Furthermore, according to the study, the average debt per family increased by 18%, which means that each family owes an average of LBP 3,430,000.00

According to VASyR, the main reason these Syrian refugees are in debt is due to the high cost of buying daily food (93%), followed by medical costs (49%) and rent costs (31%). Like in the previous year, 9 per 10 families are still burdened with debt due to insufficient basic needs.

According to response from Syrian families, the cost of healthcare had recorded a significant increase in 2019 causing them to use the facilities of medical centers provided by NGOs because the cost is lower. Therefore, cost is a major barrier for families to meet their daily needs even though access to health facilities and services is accessible.

In light of the COVID-19 pandemic, inflation and the economic collapse of Lebanon, an increase in the unemployment rate and the number of Syrian refugees and Lebanese residents in need of medical assistance have also increased, especially pregnant women and pediatrics. There is also an increase of burden in primary and secondary health centers as well as an increase in mortality and morbidity.

Therefore, the Medical Village project is initiated to raise funds to support the ultrasound and consultation costs for 2,700 pregnant women and 3,600 consultations of Syrian and Palestinian refugee children, also the Lebanese community in need. Indirectly, this Medical Village will reduce the burden on Primary and Secondary Health Centers and the level of mortality among patients.

The fund raised will be channeled to our strategic partners in Lebanon to continue the OB-GYN and Pediatric services to the Syrian refugees, Palestinian refugees and Lebanese community. Through the fund collected, these refugees will be able to undergo a regular check-up for their children considering the chronic issue of malnutrition and food insecurity often cause these children to fall ill.
 
No amount is too small in the sight of Allah. Every little bit will help towards this noble cause, even as simple as sharing this message - with no less reward!

Please share this campaign far and wide to reach maximum impact and #CirculateGood

The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Whoever relieves a Muslim of a burden from the burdens of the world, Allah will relieve him of a burden from the burdens on the Day of Judgement. [Timirdhi]

Help Quba Masjid's expansion

","description":"

Key Points:

  • In 2006, they procured an old factory in Hayes and turned it into Quba Masjid. It was rebuilt in 2017
  • However, since then the community has outgrown the masjid size and people have to pray outside on the concrete due to limited space
  • On 4th August 2023, we secured the building for extension. 2nd phase includes repaying £275,000 (MYR 1,460,000) of Qardul Hassan, submitting planning permission and designing, demolishing and rebuilding

UPDATE: 

On 4th August 2023, we secured the building for extension. 2nd phase includes repaying £275,000 (MYR 1,460,000) of Qardul Hassan, submitting planning permission and designing, demolishing and rebuilding.

Campaign Story

The name Quba Masjid is a significant one, given the special status that the Quba Masjid has - the first ever masjid built in Islam by Prophet Muhammad ﷺ himself. For the Muslims of the town of Hayes, in west London, it has certainly served the community well.

Originally opened in 2006, when they took over an old factory building and has gone through renovations and rebuilding over the years, notably in 2017.

Since then, the community has grown rapidly, and the masjid grounds can no longer fit the needs of the community. People are praying on the streets as the community keeps growing. Quba Masjid is also a centre of learning where Qur'an classes, Islamic education and other social activities are regularly held. 

To ensure the needs of the local Muslim community are met, Quba Masjid wants to procure the adjacent building to further improve the services and facilities they can offer to the public.

For this, they urgently need to raise the GBP 800,000 (MYR 4,700,000)/USD 1,030,353) required to purchase the building outright. Let's all come together to make this a reality for them! Imagine the massive benefit it will provide to the Muslims and the local community there and to forget, for you as well.

Uthman ibn Affan reported: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, “Whoever builds a mosque for Allah, Allah will build for him a house like it in Paradise.” [Bukhari, Muslim]

This is an exclusive initiative by HASAN, - Halal Startup Angels Network - a closed community of Angel Investors from around the world who come together to invest in Shariah-compliant startups with the potential for huge financial returns while circulating good in this world.

 

Dear HASAN Angels

Together, we sure can create one lasting impact. So we jio you to "Make a Commitment" to our HASAN Angels network by donating any amount to our HASAN WELL in Nigeria.

This HASAN WELL, we specially choose from many others because it has the power to change lives and communities like no other. When you join our HASAN Angels, you'll be part of a kawan-kawan working together to make the greatest impact can liao.

1 Well: MYR 8,820 (USD 2,150)

The cost of a well covers the establishment of a borehole, required equipment to enable reliable delivery of drinking water, and long-term maintenance costs required to service a well for years to come - effectively providing a long-term solution to the communities needs. An-Nadaa’s team actively does routine checks on the established boreholes to ensure the project does not just stop at the establishment of wells. Scholars have said, ''When you're giving sadaqah to a poor person, don't think of yourself as someone generous helping the needy. Rather the reality is that it's a needy person helping another needy person.'

Our mission is to create one big ripple effect, and with your support, we confirm can make sure the HASAN WELL becomes a beacon of hope, change, and growth for many people in Nigeria. So let's come together and make this commitment that will last for generations to come, hor.

Faster faster join us as a HASAN Angel and make a difference together. Ready to make a commitment?

Donate any amount now and become part of our amazing journey.

With heartfelt appreciation,

The HASAN team.

Give Relief In Cameroon

","description":"

Key Points:

  • Urgent relief is needed in the northwestern and southwest regions of Cameroon due to strife

Campaign Story

Campaign Objective

Be the Lifeline Southern Cameroon Needs: Your Support Saves Lives and Rebuilds Hope


The Crisis We Face

Our hearts are heavy as we witness the worsening crisis in Cameroon that began since 2017. Over 4,300 anglophones have been killed, and more than 4,30,0000 have fled to neighbouring countries. Families are being torn apart, and entire neighborhoods have been reduced to rubble due to relentless attacks, the houses burned to ashes. Activities have been shut down. Medical, food and water supplies are urgently needed in the Northwest and Southwest regions of Cameroon. Innocent lives keep slipping through our fingers as the clock ticks. Adding to this dire situation is the lack of electricity and clean water, turning the anglophone region into a living nightmare for its residents.

What We're Doing

IFHAG is on the ground in the affected regions. Despite being in the line of fire, they have managed to distribute 1200 essential medical items to health facilities and paid hospital bills for 103 patients. We have also been distributing daily bread, rice and food packs. We distribute clean sachet water for the most vulnerable populations and are planning further interventions. Our trained and experienced team has priority access to supplies once aid corridors open up again.

Our Approach

We aren't just about emergency relief; we believe in creating lasting change. Our team is working on not just immediate needs like Non-Food Items (NFIs), but also long-term projects like rebuilding schools, homes, hand pump wells and A not-for-proft restaurant which will be as a financial backup to us. We're partnering with other organizations to ensure your donations go as far as they possibly can. We've been on the ground since 2019, experienced and skilled; we've done this before, and we can do it again, but not without your help.

Donate today and make an impact when it's needed the most. Your donation can save lives and restore hope in the midst of darkness.

Thank you for your support.

BerryPay is our official payment gateway.

{"props":{"pageProps":{"status":true,"msg":"Campaign details","data":{"id":78880,"title":"MySakinah - A New Way of Saving Marriages","slug":"mysakinah-save-marriages","cover_image":"https://admin.globalsadaqah.com/uploads/galleries/651147cf223e8_1695631311.jpeg","cover_image_details":{"id":23,"path":"uploads/galleries/651147cf223e8_1695631311.jpeg","title":null,"description":null,"caption":null,"alt_text":"MySakinah - Way of Saving Marriages"},"thumb_caption":"

A New Way To Save Marriages

","description":"

Key Points:

  • MySakinah, an AI-Powered Muslim Marital Health company, is launching a "Save The Marriage" campaign. The goal is to revive marriages facing discord and strengthen them, hence fostering a stronger Ummah as a whole.
  • Our data-driven, innovative approach leverages the power of AI and LLM's (large language models) to further enhance the human touch of professional therapists & Muslim preachers.
  • The primary beneficiaries are families facing marital discord, thus suffering financial instability from the B40 and also M40 working class. 
  • We are targeting to raise funds to sponsor 5 families from each locality for their flagship Marriage Revival Program.

 

Campaign Story

Help Foster a Stronger Ummah, Save Families from Marriage Suicide

Marriages: Sometimes soulmates, sometimes cellmates.

MySakinah are embarking on a literal life-saving mission, to help save as many marriages as possible. With skyrocketing divorce rates not just in Malaysia but across the world, we are driven by data and sound professional Islamic guidance to nurture well-grounded families and they want you to become a vital cog in this effort.

Our Visionary Quest: 

The family is the cornerstone of which a functioning society is built upon. The trappings of modern life and in general a trend of swaying from the divine teachings from the Quran & Sunnah, have led to a decay of marital matrimony, which according to statistics made available through MySakinah, is very alarming.

Take this into account: Marital discord has more severe repercussions that we might think. Our research has shown divorces can happen for the most absurd reasons. Delving deeper, we uncover more serious underlying issues and implications, for example a spouse lying about losing their job due to stress of marriage problems, and just pretending to go to work while suffering worsening financially. 

Fun fact: Stats has also shown how divorce can have an effect on environment. How? By virtue of the separated parent having to make more trips in the car, ferrying the child from different households.

Visualize this scenario: Countless families, dispersed across Malaysia, struggling through the tumultuous waters of marital discord. These are families yearning for reconciliation, yet constrained by financial hurdles and a dearth of guidance. This is where MySakinah comes in - to provide a modern solution to age-old problems.

The Significance: 

What sets us apart is our methodical approach. We are not merely allocating resources; we are orchestrating a symphony of support. Trained personnel at selected masjid partners - Masjid Kota Damansara, Masjid Ara Damansara, Masjid Subang Airport and most recently Masjid Negara - stand ready to offer immediate aid and identify those in need of comprehensive intervention.

What Your Contribution Accomplishes:

Your support fuels our Marriage Revival Program, encompassing:

  1. Marital Education: Unlocking the potential of six dynamic modules enriched with 20 hours of enlightening video content, focusing on mindset cultivation, love enrichment, and mending skills.
  2. Counseling & Therapy: Tailored, pinpointed interventions at critical junctures of marital distress, anchored in Islamic principles.
  3. Real-time Assistance: A dedicated hotline, messaging therapy services, and live group Q&A sessions.
  4. Community Involvement: Marital Wellness Program through our Masjid partners, fostering spiritual interconnectedness.
  5. Continuous Learning & Advancement: Equipping our masjid partners with cutting-edge tools for effective community support.

Beyond the Campaign:

Our commitment stretches far beyond this campaign. We envision:

  • Continued Support for Rehabilitation
  • Assimilation into the MySakinah Community
  • Evolution of Success Stories into Marital First Responders
  • Ongoing Opportunities for Growth

Stand with Us in Sowing Harmony:

Let us sow seeds of unity and harmony in households across Malaysia. Together, we will not only revive marriages but also shape a future that is brighter, happier, and more robust for our communities.

Support the Cause! 

Each contribution fuels the flame of love, and each rekindled marriage becomes a beacon of unity. Join us in championing freedom within our families!

School For Tomorrow

","description":"

Key Campaign

Educational Waqf for a Boarding School in Taiwan

  • Secure land to establish a full Islamic boarding school in Taiwan
  • Provide a place where children grow in knowledge, faith, and character
  • Preserve Islamic identity for generations to come
  • Create a lasting sadaqah jariyah legacy

2. Overview

📖 Why this matters

No Islamic Schools in Taiwan: Muslim children lack access to comprehensive Islamic-based education, leaving a deep gap in their growth.

A Home for the Forgotten: Undocumented children of migrant workers are being abandoned or sent to orphanages, cut off from both education and their faith. A boarding school will give them dignity, belonging, and a future.

More than a School: This land will not only host classrooms, dormitories, and a mosque — but also serve as a Da’wah Center and Elderly House, reducing loneliness among revert Muslims and preserving cultural heritage.

Generational Legacy: By contributing, you are planting seeds of faith that will outlive you, becoming a continuous sadaqah jariyah for generations to come.

The Need

Land Acquisition: 1,383,639 MYR
Site Clearing & Grading: 20,754 MYR
Legal & Permit Fees: 4,150 MYR
Facility Construction: 691,819 MYR
Equipment & Furniture: 27,673 MYR
Educational Materials: 27,673 MYR

 

When you give to this Waqf, you’re not just buying land — you’re building futures.

Be the reason a child learns Qur’an in safety.
Be the reason an abandoned soul finds a home.
Be the reason Islam grows strong in Taiwan.

{"props":{"pageProps":{"status":true,"msg":"Campaign details","data":{"id":27778,"title":"Help Refugee Children Secure a Brighter Future | Phase 2","slug":"uaim-phase2","cover_image":"https://admin.globalsadaqah.com/uploads/campaign/cover_63a19b7474acd_1671535476.jpg","cover_image_details":null,"thumb_caption":"

Brighten the future for refugee kids

","description":"

Key Points

  • To date, more than 300 Rohingya refugee children are currently enrolled in UAIM.
  • This is Phase 2 of UAIM's campaign. In Phase 1, thanks to our donors and their support, we managed to secure one year's rental and utility bills to support the school.
  • Donations to this campaign will be used to complete the new Academic building and meet the expenses of procuring and other needed amenities for the classrooms.
  • A secondary aim of this campaign is to continue distributing food packs (including other necessities) to the underprivileged communities besides the Rohingya that are under the care of UAIM.

Update:

At United Arakan Institute Malaysia (UAIM), our commitment to enriching the lives of 130 refugee children, most of whom are Rohingya, has been bolstered by your invaluable support. The establishment of our computer lab has launched a new era of digital literacy, with students starting on Microsoft Office skills, setting them on a path toward future opportunities in graphic design and beyond.

Your generous donations have sustained our boarding school's fundamental needs—covering the essentials such as rent, utilities, teacher salaries, and ensuring our educational mission proceeds unhindered. This support has been pivotal, providing our students with a stable environment conducive to learning and growth.

Beyond the classroom, we've embraced agricultural self-sufficiency by growing crops that now supply half of our daily food requirements, fostering a healthy diet enriched with organic produce. This holistic approach extends to equipping each child with school uniforms, books, and covering transportation costs for six months—removing financial barriers to their education. Your contributions have been the cornerstone of these transformative changes, and we are profoundly grateful for your partnership in this journey of empowerment.

 

Latest Update

Throughout the last few months, you helped Itthadul Madaris Al Arkaniah (United Arakan Institute Malaysia) sustain and made an impact on the lives of the refugee children living there. Classes are well underway with things getting back to normal after the lockdown restrictions and online learning throughout the past year. 

The UAIM team has successfully: 

1. Revamped Surau and Wudhu area

2. Full-blown cafeteria built to provide food for over 170 children

3. Building a farm with fast-growing crops with a focus on sustainability for the school. 

4. Opened a section for Islamic Scholarship for students who want to become Alim (scholar).

5. Football and Playground built to keep children fit. 

The children have been showing great progress both in their Islamic studies, memorization of the Quran as well as their academic studies. The school recently managed to get a new science teacher with the focus on science experiments to help the students understand the world better. May Allah bless everyone for building the leaders of tomorrow. 

Previous Next

Campaign Story

Itthadul Madaris Al Arkaniah (United Arakan Institute Malaysia) a.k.a UAIM, has helped shelter displaced children torn from their families. To date, more than 300 Rohingya refugee children are currently under their care. UAIM also provides these children with quality education and necessities in hopes to give them a chance at a better future. This is Phase 2 of UAIM's campaign. In Phase 1, thanks to our donors and their support, we managed to secure one year's rental and utility bills to support the school. Today, UAIM is facing challenges to complete the new academic building and meeting expenses of the ceiling fans, chairs, tables, painting interiors, doors, partitions to separate classrooms, windows and wiring inside as well as such as any equipment such as whiteboard and projectors. With your donations, UAIM will be able to continue supporting the Rohingya Muslim children by improving the infrastructure and creating a conducive environment of the learning centre and also giving refugee children hope for a better future. Donations to this campaign will be used to complete the new Academic building and meet the expenses of procuring and other needed amenities for the classrooms. 

You will also be helping UAIM provide the children with the following vocational skills:
- Carpentry
- Sewing
- Refurbishing
- Welding
- Painting

A secondary aim of this campaign is to continue distributing food packs (including other necessities) to the underprivileged communities besides the Rohingya that are under the care of UAIM.

Let's start with just MYR 5 and help provide the gift of education to our young refugee brothers and sisters. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Whoever relieves a Muslim of a burden from the burdens of the world, Allah will relieve him of a burden from the burdens on the Day of Judgement. And whoever helps ease a difficulty in the world, Allah will grant him ease from a difficulty in the world and in the Hereafter. And whoever covers (the faults of) a Muslim, Allah will cover (his faults) for him in the world and the Hereafter. And Allah is engaged in helping the worshipper as long as the worshipper is engaged in helping his brother.” [Tirmidhi]

Salam Everyone,

Hope this message finds you well. I wanted to personally update you on the progress and activities at UAIM, made possible through your generous support.

UAIM Establishment and Growth

UAIM began in 2016 with a Tahfiz school and 10 Rohingya children at Masjid Jamek Batu 12, Puchong Selangor, under Ustaz Mohd Sayd's guidance, focusing on Islamic education. By 2018, UAIM officially expanded to include academic education, and today, it serves 150 students, blending religious teachings with a comprehensive curriculum to prepare them for a brighter future.

Recent Achievements
In the past 3-6 months, UAIM has made significant strides. We trained our teachers in advanced methods, developed student leadership programs, and integrated innovative teaching strategies. We also established a state-of-the-art ICT lab, updated our curriculum, engaged in community outreach, expanded extracurricular activities, and launched sustainability initiatives.

Future Goals
Looking ahead, our primary goal is to prepare students for IGCSE examinations by 2025 and facilitate their university enrollment. We aim to develop career counseling programs, enhance extracurricular activities, integrate advanced technology, build community and industry partnerships, promote lifelong learning, ensure emotional and mental well-being, and achieve high academic standards.

Your continued support is the cornerstone of our success. Together, we are making a significant impact on many lives. Thank you for being an essential part of this journey.

Warm regards,
Ustaz Haji Mohd Zainal bin Haji Khamis

Chairman of UAIM

When you give, they feast. When you sacrifice, they survive.

","description":"

Key Points:

  • Provide fresh Qurbani meat to 400 needy families
  • USD130/MYR550 per cattle share | USD200/RM855 per goat
  • Empower local farmers who raise the animal
  • Support communities battling food insecurity
  • Honour the spirit of sacrifice by feeding those who rarely eat meat
  • Qurban done or out of reach? Give what you can; your sadaqah still feeds the forgotten.
  • Deadline: 4 June 2025

Campaign Story:

In the fields of rural Bangladesh, livestock is more than wealth—it’s survival.

Every year, al-Adhas raise goats and cattle with care, only to be forced to sell them off to buy food, medicine, or pay off debts. Despite raising the very animals sacrificed during Eid, they themselves rarely taste the meat of Eid al-Adha.

This Qurbani, we want to change that.

With your help, we’ll bring fresh, nutritious meat to 400 struggling families in Bangladesh. These are families who often go years without protein on their plates, families who look forward to Eid not for celebration—but for relief.

Your Qurbani will do more than feed, it will empower the poor, support local farmers, and revive joy in the hearts of families who have endured too much for too long.

This Eid al-Adha, make your sacrifice count—for them.

Your Qurbani could be the only meat they eat this year.

Let your sacrifice bring smiles, strength, and sustenance to Bangladesh’s most vulnerable.

🎯 Fulfil your Qurbani with us today.
💝 Give a share, donate a goat, or contribute what you can—every portion counts.

{"props":{"pageProps":{"status":true,"msg":"Campaign details","data":{"id":62492,"title":"Bangladesh Is Drowning: Worst Floods In A Century | Bangladesh Flood 2022","slug":"bd22-floods","cover_image":"https://admin.globalsadaqah.com/uploads/campaign/cover_63ad75913c86d_1672312209.png","cover_image_details":null,"thumb_caption":"

Bangladesh Is Drowning: Worst Floods In A Century | Bangladesh Flood 2022

","description":"

Campaign Story

Heavy monsoon downpours in Bangladesh’s northeastern and northern regions have stranded millions of people. Much of the country’s northeast is underwater and the situation is getting worse as heavy downpour continues. This is a developing campaign and more information will be added as we get updates from the ground. 

27 June 2022

Five more people have died in the last 24 hours, bringing the total number of flood deaths in Bangladesh to 73, according to officials. An estimated 2,000 children were suffering from severe acute malnutrition before the floods hit.

According to UNICEF representative, Yett Sheldon lifesaving treatment for the condition also has been disrupted. Moreover, 90% of health facilities have been flooded, interrupting immunization and other vital services. 49 fatalities were reported from drowning while the rest died in flood-related cases, including lightning strikes, snake bites, diarrhoea, skin diseases, and landslides.

More than 4,000 people have been infected with waterborne diseases. Crops across the country have been devastated. Classroom activities were suspended at 4,000 primary and 917 secondary schools and were partially affected in 102 secondary schools in 18 districts.

19 June 2022

Floods in Bangladesh’s northeast have spread to other districts as heavy monsoon rains continue to pummel Sylhet and Sunamganj districts, leaving millions of people stranded without power, food and drinking water.

State Minister for Disaster Management and Relief Enamur Rahman said on Saturday the flooding is the “worst in 122 years” in the two districts as, according to him, the level of floodwater rose by 8 feet in two days.

90% of Sunamganj and 65% of Sylhet flooded. The local administration estimates around 3.5 million people have been affected by the floods in the two districts alone. The worst-hit Sunamganj district in Bangladesh is almost disconnected from the rest of the country.

18 June 2022

Lightning strikes triggered by the storms had killed at least 30+ people in Bangladesh since Friday afternoon. Among them were three children aged 12 to 14. Another four people were killed when landslides hit their hillside homes in the port city of Chittagong. 

Floods reportedly caused widespread damage to habitation, crops, roads and highways across vast swathes of the country.

Water levels in all major rivers across the country were rising, according to the flood forecasting and warning centre in Dhaka, the capital. The country has about 130 rivers. Schools have been turned into relief shelters to house entire villages inundated in a matter of hours by rivers that suddenly burst their banks. The flooding is being described as the country's worst ever.

“The situation is bad. More than four million people have been stranded by flood water,” said Sylhet region chief government administrator Mosharraf Hossain. The Sylhet region is among the worst affected. 

Nearly the entire region was without electricity. The flooding forced Bangladesh’s third-largest international airport in Sylhet to shut down on Friday.

Before this week’s rains, the Sylhet region was still recovering from its worst floods in nearly two decades late last month, when at least 10 people were killed and four million others were affected. Back to back flooding has brought the region to its knees. 

Our partners on the ground are continuously monitoring the situation and responding to emergency aid requests. The numbers are increasing as you read this and the Bangladeshi public needs all the help and support that it can get. Let's start with just RM10. Donations to this campaign will be used to provide emergency relief to Bangladeshis affected by the floods.  

The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Whoever relieves a Muslim of a burden from the burdens of the world, Allah will relieve him of a burden from the burdens on the Day of Judgement. And whoever helps ease a difficulty in the world, Allah will grant him ease from a difficulty in the world and in the Hereafter. And whoever covers (the faults of) a Muslim, Allah will cover (his faults) for him in the world and the Hereafter. And Allah is engaged in helping the worshipper as long as the worshipper is engaged in helping his brother.” [Tirmidhi]

Major Fires Engulf Refugee Camp

","description":"

Key Points 

  • Hundreds of Rohingya Refugee Tents in Bangladesh Burned which needed 2,000 Refugees to be relocated
  • An area that could accommodate atleast thousand refugees went up in flames.
  • The United Nations High Commissioner for Refugees (UNHCR) said that around 550 shelters for 3,500 refugees were completely or partly destroyed by the fire.

Campaign Story

Hundreds of Rohingya Refugee Tents in Bangladesh Burned which needed 2,000 Refugees to be relocated. A large fire broke out in the Rohingya refugee camp in Cox's Bazar, Bangladesh, on 14 January, Thursday morning. An area that could accommodate atleast thousand refugees went up in flames. This is a major blow for the refugees as they have lost nearly everything. 

Deputy Bangladesh government official for refugee affairs Mohammed Shamsud Douza said firefighters were only able to extinguish the flames after two hours of struggle. The explosion of gas cylinders from the shelter is one factor that slowed down the extinguishing process.

The United Nations High Commissioner for Refugees (UNHCR) said that around 550 shelters for 3,500 refugees were completely or partly destroyed by the fire. As many as 150 shops and facilities belonging to non-profit organizations were also burned down. 'Security experts are working with the authorities to investigate the cause of the fire,' said UNHCR.

Bangladesh is known to have started moving some Rohingya refugees to a remote island called Bhasan Char. More than 2,000 refugees have been relocated since December last year. Photos and videos at the Nayapara Camp shows the severity of the fires. 'Blok E is completely on fire. Nothing is left, nothing is saved, everything is on fire,' said Mohammad Arakani, one of the Rohingya refugees. 

Our charity partners, Rumah Zakat are on the ground assisting and helping provide aid to the refugees to help mitigate the situation.

Our donors have the unique opportunity to directly help their brothers and sisters on the ground when they need help most.

Prophet Muhammad ﷺ said: “The best of deeds is making the believer happy, such as covering his ‘awrah, satisfying his hunger or meeting his need.” [Tabarani]

25 Year Water Project: Building Wells for Poor Families in Bangladesh

","description":"

Key Points

  • Cost of 1 Well = MYR 1550 (USD 371)
  • Over 4.9 million people in Bangladesh still do not have clean water close to home.
  • Over 73 million people in Bangladesh – two in five – use contaminated water.
  • Over a 1,000+ children under 5 die from diarrhoea each year. This is primarily caused by dirty water and poor toilets. 
  • Donations to this campaign will be used to build wells that give access to safe drinking water, improved sanitation, and hygiene practices for poor families in Bangladesh.

Campaign Story

Bangladesh is the eighth-most populous country in the world, with a population of over 164 million. Despite such a large number, major parts of the country don't have the ability to access clean drinking water and even today, many drink water from sources that are extremely unhygenic.

Over 4.9 million people in Bangladesh still do not have clean water close to home. Over 73 million people in Bangladesh – two in five – use contaminated water. Over a 1,000+ children under 5 die from diarrhoea each year. This is primarily caused by dirty water and poor toilets. 

This is Phase 2 of the water well project in Bangladesh. Alhamdulillah, AlKhairi has already built 40 water wells in Phase 1. The wells aim to provide a family access to clean drinking water for cooking, washing and most essentially drinking.

This campaign focuses on providing water well across rural villages in Bangladesh, along with periodic maintenance to ensure the well is properly maintained for the use of the communities. The water well is guaranteed to last 25 years and it can serve multiple family generations InshaAllah. 

Donations to this campaign will be used to build wells that give access to safe drinking water, improved sanitation, and hygiene practices for poor families in Bangladesh.   Let us come together and help the poor and underprivileged in Bangladesh with the gift of water. Just RM10 can go a long way in changing their lives and bringing smiles on their faces. We invite people to donate as a family so it is as though your family is giving a gift of a well to another poor family in Bangladesh.
Sa’ad ibn Ubadah asked the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, “Which charity is best?” The Prophet ﷺ said, “A drink of water.” 
The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, “When a man dies, his deeds come to an end except for three things: Sadaqah Jariyah (ceaseless charity); a knowledge which is beneficial, or a virtuous descendant who prays for him.” [Muslim]
Even if you cannot sponsor an entire well, your donations will be used to support the existing wells and help in their maintenance.

Empower Youths with Severe Autism

","description":"

Key Points

  • Raudhah Autisme is formed by families with children who have severe (low-functioning) autism and require lifelong, high-level care and daily support.
  • In Malaysia, care for these individuals traditionally falls solely on immediate family, often burdening siblings after parents pass away.
  • The organisation plans to build Malaysia’s first Independent Living Skills Centre (ILSC) for youths with severe autism, complete with a residential facility and community support centre.
  • The centre will include Restorative Farm Therapy, cottage industry training (e.g., selling vegetables/mushrooms), and vocational programs to help these youths develop basic skills for independence.
  • Land has been purchased in Jenderam Hulu, Dengkil, and they are now raising funds from the public and private sectors to build the facility and realise this vision.

Campaign Story

Raudhah Autisme is a community of families with children who have severe (low-functioning) autism—individuals who require lifelong, high-level care and daily support. In Malaysia, care for such individuals is traditionally left entirely to the immediate family, often placing a heavy burden on siblings after the passing of parents.

To address this critical gap, Raudhah Autisme plans to build Malaysia’s first Independent Living Skills Centre (ILSC) for youths with severe autism. This centre will offer not just a residential facility but also a community autism support centre, Restorative Farm Therapy through urban farming, cottage industry training (like selling vegetables and mushrooms), and vocational programs to equip these youths with basic skills for a degree of independence and dignity.

They have already purchased land in Jenderam Hulu, Dengkil, and now seek public and private support to raise funds to build this pioneering facility—giving these youths a future where they are not left behind.

Raudhah Autisme (RA) was founded by 17 families who have children with low-functioning autism. Traditionally, individuals with low-functioning disabilities in Malaysia rely entirely on their families for care throughout their lives. However, in today’s world where life is increasingly difficult and challenging, we realise that it is unfair to expect siblings to take over the responsibilities of parents once they are gone.

The idea behind the establishment of RA is a new and pioneering concept. The parents of RA chose to take the lead in setting up the Raudhah Autisme community home — a Centre for Independent Living for youths with autism.

Despite facing various challenges, the RA group decided to move forward by pooling internal resources and raising funds together.

Raudhah Autisme is a registered organisation with ROS No: PPM-017-10-07072019 & was established on 7 July 2019.

USD 2 (MYR 8) = 10 Loaves | Feed a Family, Save a Life

","description":"

Key Points

  • Yemen is facing one of the worst humanitarian crises globally.
  • Over 17 million people suffer from chronic hunger, with millions of children malnourished.
  • Years of conflict have collapsed the economy and cut off food supplies to vulnerable populations.
  • Partnered with a local bakery to produce ~3,000 loaves daily.
  • Bread is distributed to displaced families and vulnerable communities.
  • Iltizam collaborates with trusted local NGOS for safe and effective distribution.
  • Bread is a basic, affordable, filling staple — crucial in crisis settings.
  • One of the few accessible foods that can be quickly produced and distributed.Campaign Story
  • This campaign is zakat-eligible

Campaign Story

Yemen is on the brink of famine.
More than 17 million people are facing chronic hunger, anbarakahons of children are suffering from life-threatening malnutrition. Years of relentless conflict have not only claimed lives but have destroyed food supply chains, crippled the economy, and shattered the country’s basic infrastructure. For many families, even a loaf of bread is a rare luxury.

To combat this crisis, Iltizam launched the Bakery Project in Taiz, southern Yemen.

Since 2017, we’ve been distributing fresh, free bread daily to displaced families and the most vulnerable communities. In partnership with a trusted local bakery, the project now produces 3,000 loaves of bread every day — warm, nourishing, and delivered straight to those in need.

Why bread?
Because in Yemen, bread is life. It’s simple, affordable, and vital for survival. It gives energy, comfort, and a sense of normalcy in the middle of chaos. It feeds not just the body, but the soul.

For just RM6, you can provide 10 loaves of bread to a hungry family.
Your donation becomes a lifeline — a gesture of mercy, a symbol of solidarity, a spark of hope in a war-torn land.

This is more than food.
It’s a reminder that the ummah stands together. That we never forget our brothers and sisters. That even something as humble as bread can carry immense barakah.

Teach Gaza

","description":"

Key Points

  • Improve access to education – ensuring students continue their learning despite the devastation.
  • Provide psycho-social support – helping children cope with stress, anxiety, and trauma.
  • Enhance resilience – through education and structured activities, we can help them heal and rebuild.
  • This campaign will benefit 10,000 primary school students in Gaza.

Campaign Story

Imagine being a child who wakes up to the sound of explosions instead of a school bell. Who holds a torn book instead of a toy. Who dreams not of playing in the park but of a day when they can learn, read, and hope again.

This is the heartbreaking reality for thousands of children in Gaza.

War has stolen their homes. Their families. Their schools. But it will not steal their future— not if we stand together.

In Knowledge We Live – A Lifeline for Gaza’s Students

We are launching “In Knowledge We Live”—a campaign to restore hope, education, and emotional healing to over 10,000 primary school students in Gaza.

These children have already lost too much. They deserve the right to learn, to dream, to rebuild.

Your generosity will go towards:

  • Organising safe learning environments in schools and shelter centres.
  • Providing essential school supplies – books, notebooks, and stationery.
  • Paying teachers’ salaries to ensure continuous education.
  • Providing daily meals so no child studies on an empty stomach.
  • Organising extracurricular activities to bring joy and hope back into their lives.

Every RM counts. Every donation brings us closer to giving these children a chance at a future beyond war and suffering.

Will you be the reason a child in Gaza learns to read, to count, to dream again?

Donate Now – Because Education is Their Lifeline.

A Gift of Life: Providing Clean Drinking Water Across Indonesia

","description":"

Key Points

  • About 18 million Indonesians lack safe water and 20 million lack access to improved sanitation facilities.
  • The Environment and Forestry Ministry (KLHK) said 59% of rivers in Indonesia are still severely polluted.
  • Penderma has developed a filtration machine to provide clean drinking water for public consumption.
  • Cost of machine: IDR 65,000,000 (USD 4009/ MYR 18,796) - This includes installation costs as well.

UPDATE:

Thanks to the #ParaPenderma assistance, two units of Free Drinking Water Stations (AMG) have been installed at Masjid Al-Lathiif and Pondok Pesantren Al-Ittifaq. This remarkable initiative serves three primary objectives: firstly, to address water scarcity issues in these sacred places of worship and learning; secondly, to promote eco-friendly and sustainable practices, particularly in the consumption of clean water; and thirdly, to prioritize the health and motivation of the dedicated Santri on their spiritual and educational journey.

Campaign Story

With a population of 273 million people, Indonesia is the fourth most populous country in the world and claims Southeast Asia’s largest economy. About 18 million Indonesians lack safe water and 20 million lack access to improved sanitation facilities. These numbers are just estimates and the reality on the ground is expected to be much worse.  

The Environment and Forestry Ministry (KLHK) said 59% of rivers in Indonesia are still severely polluted. The sources of river water pollution include industrial waste, such as oil, gas, and mining, as well as domestic or household waste and livestock waste.This leads to even bigger issues, because the provision of safe water, sanitation and hygienic conditions are essential to battle many diseases. 

Penderma is a philanthropic organisation under Yayasan Aksi Indonesia Dermawan that focuses on sustainability. Looking at the immense need for access to clean water, Penderma has developed a filtration machine to provide clean drinking water for public consumption. The technology is built in-house by Penderma itself. The machine purifies water using filters, ultrafiltration, reverse osmosis and ultraviolet to produce water that is ready to drink. This filtration system can be implemented for any public area or building like masajid, orphanages etc.

- Cost of machine: IDR 65,000,000 (USD 4009, MYR 18,796) - This includes installation costs as well. 
- Weight and Size of machine: 50kg - 160x60x60
- Water Filtered: 1900 litres/day
- Penderma provides free guarantee and maintenance for 5 years
- ISO & Halal Certified

 

46 water filtration machines were installed across Indonesia in 2021 alone. This was mainly in remote masajid and madrasahs. The team aims to install more units in Islamic boarding schools and orphanages to make it easy for underprivileged communities.

Sa’ad ibn Ubadah asked the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, “Which charity is best?” The Prophet ﷺ said, “A drink of water.” 

The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Whoever relieves a Muslim of a burden from the burdens of the world, Allah will relieve him of a burden from the burdens on the Day of Judgement. [Timirdhi]

I hope you're doing well. I wanted to take a moment to share some important updates with you about our ongoing efforts to improve access to clean water in our communities.

Currently, only 11.9% of our population has access to safe drinking water. At Penderma.id, with your invaluable support, we are committed to changing this reality.

Here's what we've achieved together over the last three years:

  • 46 Free Drinking Water Facilities Established: These facilities are crucial in areas where water safety is a major concern.
  • 1.5 Million Liters of Clean Water Distributed: Each liter is a step towards better health and well-being.
  • 2.8 Million Beneficiaries: Thanks to your support, millions now have access to safer water.
  • 44 Locations Reached Across Indonesia: Our impact is growing, thanks to the collective effort of our supporters and partners.

Our goal for 2024 is ambitious yet within reach: we aim to establish 100 free drinking water facilities across the nation. Each new facility brings us closer to a healthier, hydrated Indonesia.

Your ongoing support is the driving force behind our mission. Together, we can ensure that access to clean water is a right enjoyed by everyone.

Thank you for being an essential part of this journey.

Warm regards,

Khirzan N. Noe’man

CEO, Penderma.id
